mūṣakairvṛṣadaṃśāśca dvīpino vividhairmṛgaiḥ..6.4.10..
5.4.d:
क्रीडंति नकुलाः सर्पैरूलूका यत्र वायसैः.
मूषकैर्वृषदंशाश्च द्वीपिनो विविधैर्मृगैः..6.4.10..
5.4.m: where mongooses play with snakes, owls with crows, / and cats with mice, and leopards with various kinds of deer.

5.4.s:
athāpaśyannadītīre sa tapasvigaṇāvṛtam.
svādhyāyanirataṃ dāṃtaṃ viśvāmitraṃ taponidhinam..6.4.11..
5.4.d:
अथापश्यन्नदीतीरे स तपस्विगणावृतम्.
स्वाध्यायनिरतं दांतं विश्वामित्रं तपोनिधिनम्..6.4.11..
5.4.m: Then he saw on the riverbank, surrounded by a host of ascetics, / Viśvāmitra, a treasury of austerity, subdued, devoted to sacred study,

5.4.s:
tejasā tapasātīva dīpyamānamivānalam.
cīravalkalasaṃvītaṃ śālavṛkṣaṃ samāśritam..6.4.12..
5.4.d:
तेजसा तपसातीव दीप्यमानमिवानलम्.
चीरवल्कलसंवीतं शालवृक्षं समाश्रितम्..6.4.12..
5.4.m: blazing like fire with his splendor and great austerity, / clad in rags and bark garments, resting against a śāla tree.

5.4.s:
atha gatvā sa rājendro dūrastho'pi praṇamya tam.
aṣṭāṃgena praṇāmena svanāma parikīrtayan..6.4.13..
5.4.d:
अथ गत्वा स राजेन्द्रो दूरस्थोऽपि प्रणम्य तम्.
अष्टांगेन प्रणामेन स्वनाम परिकीर्तयन्..6.4.13..
5.4.m: Then, approaching, that foremost of kings, remaining at a distance, bowed down to him / with a prostration of eight limbs, proclaiming his own name.

5.4.s:
tathānyānapi tacchiṣyānkṛtāñjalipuṭaḥ sthitaḥ.
yathākramaṃ yathājyeṣṭhaṃ śraddhayā parayā yutaḥ..6.4.14..
5.4.d:
तथान्यानपि तच्छिष्यान्कृताञ्जलिपुटः स्थितः.
यथाक्रमं यथाज्येष्ठं श्रद्धया परया युतः..6.4.14..
5.4.m: And in the same way he stood with folded hands before his other disciples, / in order according to seniority, filled with supreme faith.

5.4.s:
dhūlidhūsaritāṃgaṃ taṃ te tu dṛṣṭvā mahīpatim.
caṃḍāla iti manvānāścihnairgātrasamudbhavaiḥ..6.4.15..
5.4.d:
धूलिधूसरितांगं तं ते तु दृष्ट्वा महीपतिम्.
चंडाल इति मन्वानाश्चिह्नैर्गात्रसमुद्भवैः..6.4.15..
5.4.m: Seeing that king whose limbs were covered in dust, / and considering him a cāṇḍāla on account of the marks produced upon his body,

5.4.s:
bhartsayāmāsurevātha vacanaiḥ paruṣākṣaraiḥ.
dhikchabdaiśca tathaivānye yāhiyāhīti cāsakṛt..6.4.16..
5.4.d:
भर्त्सयामासुरेवाथ वचनैः परुषाक्षरैः.
धिक्छब्दैश्च तथैवान्ये याहियाहीति चासकृत्..6.4.16..
5.4.m: they immediately rebuked him with harsh words / and cries of ‘Fie!’, and others repeatedly said, ‘Go away! Go away!

5.4.s:
kastvaṃ pāpeha saṃprāpto munīnāmāśramottame.
vedadhvanisamākīrṇe sādhūnāmapi durlabhe..6.4.17..
5.4.d:
कस्त्वं पापेह संप्राप्तो मुनीनामाश्रमोत्तमे.
वेदध्वनिसमाकीर्णे साधूनामपि दुर्लभे..6.4.17..
5.4.m: Who are you, evil one, who have arrived here at this excellent hermitage of sages, / filled with the sound of the Vedas and hard even for the virtuous to attain?

5.4.s:
tasmādgaccha drutaṃ yāvanna kaścittāpasastava.
dattvā śāpaṃ karotyāśu prāṇānāmapi saṃkṣayam..6.4.18..
5.4.d:
तस्माद्गच्छ द्रुतं यावन्न कश्चित्तापसस्तव.
दत्त्वा शापं करोत्याशु प्राणानामपि संक्षयम्..6.4.18..
5.4.m: Therefore go away quickly, before some ascetic / pronounces a curse and brings about even the destruction of your life!’”

5.4.s:
triśaṃkuruvāca.
triśaṃkurnāma bhūpo'haṃ sūryavaṃśasamudbhavaḥ.
śapto vasiṣṭhaputraiśca caṃḍālatve niyojitaḥ..6.4.19..
5.4.d:
त्रिशंकुरुवाच.
त्रिशंकुर्नाम भूपोऽहं सूर्यवंशसमुद्भवः.
शप्तो वसिष्ठपुत्रैश्च चंडालत्वे नियोजितः..6.4.19..
5.4.m: Triśaṅku said: / “I am the king named Triśaṅku, born of the Solar race. / Cursed by the sons of Vasiṣṭha, I have been cast into the condition of a cāṇḍāla.

5.4.s:
so'haṃ śaraṇamāpannaḥ śāpamuktyai dvijottamāḥ.
viśvāmitraṃ jaganmitraṃ nānyā me'sti gatiḥ parā..6.4.20..
5.4.d:
सोऽहं शरणमापन्नः शापमुक्त्यै द्विजोत्तमाः.
विश्वामित्रं जगन्मित्रं नान्या मेऽस्ति गतिः परा..6.4.20..
5.4.m: As such, I have come seeking refuge with Viśvāmitra, the friend of the world, for release from the curse, O best of the twice-born; / I have no other supreme refuge.”

5.4.s:
viśvāmitra uvāca.
vasiṣṭhasya bhavānyājyastatputrāṇāṃ viśeṣataḥ.
tatkasmādīdṛśe pāpe taistvamadya niyojitaḥ..6.4.21..
5.4.d:
विश्वामित्र उवाच.
वसिष्ठस्य भवान्याज्यस्तत्पुत्राणां विशेषतः.
तत्कस्मादीदृशे पापे तैस्त्वमद्य नियोजितः..6.4.21..
5.4.m: Viśvāmitra said: / “You are the patron of Vasiṣṭha, and especially of his sons. / Why then have you been reduced by them today to such an evil state?

5.4.s:
ko'parādhastvayā teṣāṃ kṛtaḥ pārthivasattama.
prāṇadrohaḥ kṛtaḥ kiṃ vā dāradharṣaṇasaṃbhavaḥ..6.4.22..
5.4.d:
कोऽपराधस्त्वया तेषां कृतः पार्थिवसत्तम.
प्राणद्रोहः कृतः किं वा दारधर्षणसंभवः..6.4.22..
5.4.m: What offense was committed by you against them, O best of kings? / Was an attack made on their lives, or did you assault a wife?”

5.4.s:
triśaṃkuruvāca.
anenaiva śarīreṇa svargāya gamanaṃ prati.
mayā saṃprārthito yajño vasiṣṭhānmunisattamāt..6.4.23..
5.4.d:
त्रिशंकुरुवाच.
अनेनैव शरीरेण स्वर्गाय गमनं प्रति.
मया संप्रार्थितो यज्ञो वसिष्ठान्मुनिसत्तमात्..6.4.23..
5.4.m: Triśaṅku said: / “I requested a sacrifice from Vasiṣṭha, the best of sages, / for the purpose of ascending to heaven with this very body.

5.4.s:
tenoktaṃ na sa yajño'sti yena svarge pragamyate.
anenaiva śarīreṇa muktvā dehāṃtaraṃ nṛpa..6.4.24..
5.4.d:
तेनोक्तं न स यज्ञोऽस्ति येन स्वर्गे प्रगम्यते.
अनेनैव शरीरेण मुक्त्वा देहांतरं नृप..6.4.24..
5.4.m: He said: ‘There is no such sacrifice by which one goes to heaven / in this very body, without taking another body, O king.’

5.4.s:
tacchrutvā sa mayā prokto yadi māṃ na nayiṣyati.
svargaṃ cānena kāyena sadyo yajñaprabhāvataḥ..6.4.25..
5.4.d:
तच्छ्रुत्वा स मया प्रोक्तो यदि मां न नयिष्यति.
स्वर्गं चानेन कायेन सद्यो यज्ञप्रभावतः..6.4.25..
5.4.m: Having heard that, I said to him: ‘If you will not take me / to heaven in this body at once by the power of a sacrifice,

5.4.s:
tadanyaṃ gurumevādya kartāhaṃ nāsti saṃśayaḥ.
etajjñātvā muniḥ prāha yatkṣemaṃ tatsamācara..6.4.26..
5.4.d:
तदन्यं गुरुमेवाद्य कर्ताहं नास्ति संशयः.
एतज्ज्ञात्वा मुनिः प्राह यत्क्षेमं तत्समाचर..6.4.26..
5.4.m: then I shall certainly adopt another guru today, there is no doubt.’ / Knowing this, the sage said: ‘Do whatever is wholesome.’

5.4.s:
tato'haṃ tena saṃtyaktastatputrānprāpya niṣṭhurān.
proktavānatha tatsarvaṃ yadvasiṣṭhasya kīrtitam..6.4.27..
5.4.d:
ततोऽहं तेन संत्यक्तस्तत्पुत्रान्प्राप्य निष्ठुरान्.
प्रोक्तवानथ तत्सर्वं यद्वसिष्ठस्य कीर्तितम्..6.4.27..
5.4.m: Then, having been rejected by him, I approached his cruel sons / and told them all that had been declared by Vasiṣṭha.

5.4.s:
tatastaiḥ śokasaṃtaptaiḥ śaptosmi munisattama.
nītaścemāṃ daśāṃ pāpāṃ caṃḍālatve niyojitaḥ..6.4.28..
5.4.d:
ततस्तैः शोकसंतप्तैः शप्तोस्मि मुनिसत्तम.
नीतश्चेमां दशां पापां चंडालत्वे नियोजितः..6.4.28..
5.4.m: Then, inflamed with rage, they cursed me, O best of sages; / I was reduced to this wretched condition and cast into the status of a cāṇḍāla.

5.4.s:
so'haṃ tvāṃ manasā dhyātvā sudūrādiharāgataḥ(?).
āśāṃ garīyasīṃ kṛtvā kurukṣetre munīśvara..6.4.29..
5.4.d:
सोऽहं त्वां मनसा ध्यात्वा सुदूरादिहरागतः(?).
आशां गरीयसीं कृत्वा कुरुक्षेत्रे मुनीश्वर..6.4.29..
5.4.m: Meditating on you in my mind, having placed great hope in you, / I have come here to Kurukṣetra from very far away, O lord of sages.

5.4.s:
nāsādhyaṃ vidyate kiṃcittriṣu lokeṣu te mune.
tasmātkuru pratīkāraṃ duḥkhitasya mamādhunā..6.4.30..
5.4.d:
नासाध्यं विद्यते किंचित्त्रिषु लोकेषु ते मुने.
तस्मात्कुरु प्रतीकारं दुःखितस्य ममाधुना..6.4.30..
5.4.m: There is nothing impossible for you in the three worlds, O sage! / Therefore, provide a remedy for me who am miserable now.”

5.4.s:
sūta uvāca.
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā viśvāmitro munīśvaraḥ.
vasiṣṭhaspardhayovāca munimadhye vyavasthitaḥ..6.4.31..
5.4.d:
सूत उवाच.
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा विश्वामित्रो मुनीश्वरः.
वसिष्ठस्पर्धयोवाच मुनिमध्ये व्यवस्थितः..6.4.31..
5.4.m: Sūta said: / Having heard those words of his, Viśvāmitra, the lord of sages, / sitting in the midst of the sages, spoke out of rivalry with Vasiṣṭha:

5.4.s:
ahaṃ tvāṃ yājayiṣyāmi tena yajñena pārthiva.
gacchasi tridivaṃ yena iṣṭamātreṇa tatkṣaṇāt..6.4.32..
5.4.d:
अहं त्वां याजयिष्यामि तेन यज्ञेन पार्थिव.
गच्छसि त्रिदिवं येन इष्टमात्रेण तत्क्षणात्..6.4.32..
5.4.m: “I shall perform that sacrifice for you, O king, / by which, immediately upon its being offered, you will go to heaven at that very moment.”

5.4.s:
tvamevaṃ vihito bhūpa vāsiṣṭhairaṃtyajastu taiḥ.
mayā bhūyo'pi bhūpālaḥ kartavyo nātra saṃśayaḥ..6.4.33..
5.4.d:
त्वमेवं विहितो भूप वासिष्ठैरंत्यजस्तु तैः.
मया भूयोऽपि भूपालः कर्तव्यो नात्र संशयः..6.4.33..
5.4.m: "O king, though you were made an outcaste in this way by the sons of Vasiṣṭha, / you shall certainly be made king again by me; of this there is no doubt.

5.4.s:
tasmādāgaccha bhūpāla tīrthayātrāṃ mayā saha.
kuru tīrthaprabhāveṇa yena tvaṃ syāḥ śuciḥ punaḥ..6.4.34..
5.4.d:
तस्मादागच्छ भूपाल तीर्थयात्रां मया सह.
कुरु तीर्थप्रभावेण येन त्वं स्याः शुचिः पुनः..6.4.34..
5.4.m: Therefore, come, O king, on a pilgrimage to sacred fords with me; / undertake it, so that through the power of the sacred fords you may become pure once more,

5.4.s:
tathā yajñakriyārhaśca caṃḍālatvavivarjitaḥ.
nāsti tatpātakaṃ yacca tīrthasnānānna naśyati..6.4.35..
5.4.d:
तथा यज्ञक्रियार्हश्च चंडालत्वविवर्जितः.
नास्ति तत्पातकं यच्च तीर्थस्नानान्न नश्यति..6.4.35..
5.4.m: and fit for sacrificial rites, freed from the state of a caṇḍāla. / There is no sin that does not perish through ritual ablution in a sacred ford."

5.4.s:
sūta uvāca.
evaṃ sa niścayaṃ kṛtvā gādhiputro munīśvaraḥ.
triśaṃkuṃ pṛṣṭhataḥ kṛtvā tīrthayātrāmathāvrajat..6.4.36..
5.4.d:
सूत उवाच.
एवं स निश्चयं कृत्वा गाधिपुत्रो मुनीश्वरः.
त्रिशंकुं पृष्ठतः कृत्वा तीर्थयात्रामथाव्रजत्..6.4.36..
5.4.m: Sūta said: / Having made this resolve, the lord of sages, the son of Gādhi, / keeping Triśaṅku behind him, set out on a pilgrimage to sacred fords.

5.4.s:
kurukṣetraṃ sarasvatyāṃ prabhāse kurujāṃgale.
pṛthūdake gayāśīrṣe naimiṣe puṣkaratraye..6.4.37..
5.4.d:
कुरुक्षेत्रं सरस्वत्यां प्रभासे कुरुजांगले.
पृथूदके गयाशीर्षे नैमिषे पुष्करत्रये..6.4.37..
5.4.m: [He went to] Kurukṣetra, to the Sarasvatī, Prabhāsa, Kurujāṅgala, / Pṛthūdaka, Gayāśīrṣa, Naimiṣa, and the three Puṣkaras;

5.4.s:
vārāṇasyāṃ prayāge ca kedāre śravaṇe nade.
citrakūṭe ca gokarṇe śāligrāme'caleśvare..6.4.38..
5.4.d:
वाराणस्यां प्रयागे च केदारे श्रवणे नदे.
चित्रकूटे च गोकर्णे शालिग्रामेऽचलेश्वरे..6.4.38..
5.4.m: to Vārāṇasī, Prayāga, Kedāra, Śravaṇa on the river, / Citrakūṭa, Gokarṇa, Śāligrāma, and Acaleśvara;

5.4.s:
śuklatīrthe surājyākhye dṛṣadvati nade śubhe.
athānyeṣu supuṇyeṣu tīrtheṣvāyataneṣu ca..6.4.39..
5.4.d:
शुक्लतीर्थे सुराज्याख्ये दृषद्वति नदे शुभे.
अथान्येषु सुपुण्येषु तीर्थेष्वायतनेषु च..6.4.39..
5.4.m: to Śuklatīrtha, to the one called Surājya, to the auspicious Dṛṣadvatī river, / and then to other most holy sacred fords and shrines.

5.4.s:
evaṃ tasya nareṃdrasya sārdhaṃ tena mahātmanā.
atikrāṃto mahānkālo bhramamāṇasya bhūtale..6.4.40..
5.4.d:
एवं तस्य नरेंद्रस्य सार्धं तेन महात्मना.
अतिक्रांतो महान्कालो भ्रममाणस्य भूतले..6.4.40..
5.4.m: Thus, as he wandered over the surface of the earth together with that great-souled [sage], / a long time passed for that lord of men.

5.4.s:
mucyate na ca pāpena caṃḍālatvena sa dvijāḥ.
evaṃvidheṣu tīrtheṣu snātopi ca pṛthakpṛthak..6.4.41..
5.4.d:
मुच्यते न च पापेन चंडालत्वेन स द्विजाः.
एवंविधेषु तीर्थेषु स्नातोपि च पृथक्पृथक्..6.4.41..
5.4.m: Yet, O twice-born ones, he was not freed from the sin of being a caṇḍāla, / even though he performed ritual ablutions one by one at such sacred fords.

5.4.s:
tataḥ kramātsamāyātaḥ so'rbudaṃ parvataṃ prati.
tatrāruhya samālokya pāpaghnamacaleśvaram..6.4.42..
5.4.d:
ततः क्रमात्समायातः सोऽर्बुदं पर्वतं प्रति.
तत्रारुह्य समालोक्य पापघ्नमचलेश्वरम्..6.4.42..
5.4.m: Then, in due course, he came toward Mount Arbuda. / Climbing up there and beholding Acaleśvara, the destroyer of sins,

5.4.s:
yāvadāyatanāttasmānnirgacchati munīśvaraḥ.
tāvattenekṣito nāmamārkaṃḍo munisattamaḥ..6.4.43..
5.4.d:
यावदायतनात्तस्मान्निर्गच्छति मुनीश्वरः.
तावत्तेनेक्षितो नाममार्कंडो मुनिसत्तमः..6.4.43..
5.4.m: as the lord of sages was departing from that shrine, / just then the best of sages, named Mārkaṇḍeya, was seen by him.

5.4.s:
so'pi dṛṣṭvā jaganmitraṃ viśvāmitraṃ munīśvaram.
provācātha kutaḥ prāptaḥ sāṃprataṃ tvaṃ munīśvara..6.4.44..
5.4.d:
सोऽपि दृष्ट्वा जगन्मित्रं विश्वामित्रं मुनीश्वरम्.
प्रोवाचाथ कुतः प्राप्तः सांप्रतं त्वं मुनीश्वर..6.4.44..
5.4.m: He too, seeing Viśvāmitra, the friend of the world and lord of sages, / then spoke: "Whence have you arrived now, O lord of sages?

5.4.s:
ko'yaṃ tavānugo raudro dṛśyate cāṃtyajākṛtiḥ.
etatsarvaṃ samācakṣva pṛcchato mama sanmune..6.4.45..
5.4.d:
कोऽयं तवानुगो रौद्रो दृश्यते चांत्यजाकृतिः.
एतत्सर्वं समाचक्ष्व पृच्छतो मम सन्मुने..6.4.45..
5.4.m: Who is this terrible follower of yours, who looks like an outcaste? / Relate all this to me as I ask, O virtuous sage."

5.4.s:
viśvāmitra uvāca.
eṣa pārthivaśārdūlastriśaṃkuriti viśrutaḥ.
vasiṣṭhasya sutairnītaścaṃḍālatvaṃ prakopataḥ..6.4.46..
5.4.d:
विश्वामित्र उवाच.
एष पार्थिवशार्दूलस्त्रिशंकुरिति विश्रुतः.
वसिष्ठस्य सुतैर्नीतश्चंडालत्वं प्रकोपतः..6.4.46..
5.4.m: Viśvāmitra said: / "This is the tiger among kings known as Triśaṅku. / He was reduced to the state of a caṇḍāla by the sons of Vasiṣṭha out of wrath.

5.4.s:
mayā cāsya pratijñātaṃ saptadvīpavatīṃ mahīm.
prabhramiṣyāmyahaṃ yāvanmedhyatvaṃ tvamupeṣyasi..6.4.47..
5.4.d:
मया चास्य प्रतिज्ञातं सप्तद्वीपवतीं महीम्.
प्रभ्रमिष्याम्यहं यावन्मेध्यत्वं त्वमुपेष्यसि..6.4.47..
5.4.m: And I pledged to him: 'I will wander the earth with its seven continents / until you regain purity.'

5.4.s:
bhrāṃto'haṃ bhūtale yāni tīrthānyāyatanāni ca.
nacaiṣa medhyatāṃ prāptaḥ pariśrāṃtosmi sāṃpratam..6.4.48..
5.4.d:
भ्रांतोऽहं भूतले यानि तीर्थान्यायतनानि च.
नचैष मेध्यतां प्राप्तः परिश्रांतोस्मि सांप्रतम्..6.4.48..
5.4.m: I have wandered to whatever sacred fords and shrines exist on the surface of the earth, / yet he has not attained purity; and now I am exhausted.

5.4.s:
tasmātsarvāṃ mahīṃ tyaktvā lajjayā parayā yutaḥ.
dvīpānmahārṇavāṃstyaktvā saṃprayāsyāmyataḥ param..6.4.49..
5.4.d:
तस्मात्सर्वां महीं त्यक्त्वा लज्जया परया युतः.
द्वीपान्महार्णवांस्त्यक्त्वा संप्रयास्याम्यतः परम्..6.4.49..
5.4.m: Therefore, abandoning the whole earth, filled with supreme shame, / leaving behind the continents and great oceans, I shall depart beyond this,

5.4.s:
mā vasiṣṭhasya putrāṇāmupahāsapadaṃ gataḥ.
pratijñārahito vipra satyamedbravīmyaham..6.4.50..
5.4.d:
मा वसिष्ठस्य पुत्राणामुपहासपदं गतः.
प्रतिज्ञारहितो विप्र सत्यमेद्ब्रवीम्यहम्..6.4.50..
5.4.m: lest I become an object of ridicule to the sons of Vasiṣṭha, / having failed in my vow, O brahmin; I tell you the truth."

5.4.s:
śrīmārkaṃḍeya uvāca.
yadyevaṃ muniśārdūla kuruṣva vacanaṃ mama.
saptadvīpavatīṃ pṛthvīṃ mā tyaktvā kutracidvraja..6.4.51..
5.4.d:
श्रीमार्कंडेय उवाच.
यद्येवं मुनिशार्दूल कुरुष्व वचनं मम.
सप्तद्वीपवतीं पृथ्वीं मा त्यक्त्वा कुत्रचिद्व्रज..6.4.51..
5.4.m: The venerable Mārkaṇḍeya said: / "If it is so, O tiger among sages, heed my word: / do not go anywhere abandoning the earth with its seven continents.

5.4.s:
etasmātparvatātkṣetraṃ hāṭakeśvarasaṃjñitam.
asti nairṛtadigbhāge deśe cānartasaṃjñake..6.4.52..
5.4.d:
एतस्मात्पर्वतात्क्षेत्रं हाटकेश्वरसंज्ञितम्.
अस्ति नैरृतदिग्भागे देशे चानर्तसंज्ञके..6.4.52..
5.4.m: To the southwest of this mountain, in the country called Ānarta, / there is a sacred field named Hāṭakeśvara.

5.4.s:
tatrādyaṃ sthāpitaṃ liṃgaṃ hāṭakena surottamaiḥ.
yattatsaṃkīrtyate loke pātāle hāṭakeśvaram..6.4.53..
5.4.d:
तत्राद्यं स्थापितं लिंगं हाटकेन सुरोत्तमैः.
यत्तत्संकीर्त्यते लोके पाताले हाटकेश्वरम्..6.4.53..
5.4.m: There the primeval liṅga was installed of gold by the best of the gods, / which is celebrated in the world as Hāṭakeśvara in Pātāla;

5.4.s:
pātālajāhnavītoyaṃ yatraivāsti dvijottama.
uddhṛte śaṃbhunā liṃge viniṣkrāṃtaṃ rasātalāt..6.4.54..
5.4.d:
पातालजाह्नवीतोयं यत्रैवास्ति द्विजोत्तम.
उद्धृते शंभुना लिंगे विनिष्क्रांतं रसातलात्..6.4.54..
5.4.m: where the water of the celestial Gaṅgā of Pātāla exists, O best of the twice-born, / which emerged from Rasātala when the liṅga was lifted up by Śambhu.

5.4.s:
tatra praviśya yatnena pātālaṃ vasudhādhipaḥ.
karotu jāhnavītoye snānaṃ śraddhāsamanvitaḥ..6.4.55..
5.4.d:
तत्र प्रविश्य यत्नेन पातालं वसुधाधिपः.
करोतु जाह्नवीतोये स्नानं श्रद्धासमन्वितः..6.4.55..
5.4.m: Entering Pātāla there with effort, let the ruler of the earth / take a ritual ablution in the water of the celestial Gaṅgā, full of faith.

5.4.s:
paścātpaśyatu talliṃgaṃ hāṭakeśvarasaṃjñitam.
bhaviṣyati tataḥ śuddhaścaṃḍālatvavivarjitaḥ..6.4.56..
5.4.d:
पश्चात्पश्यतु तल्लिंगं हाटकेश्वरसंज्ञितम्.
भविष्यति ततः शुद्धश्चंडालत्वविवर्जितः..6.4.56..
5.4.m: Afterward, let him behold that liṅga named Hāṭakeśvara; / then he will become pure, freed from the state of a caṇḍāla.

5.4.s:
tvamapi prāpsyasi śreyaḥ paraṃ hṛdayasaṃsthitam.
tatonyadapi yatkiṃcittatraiva tapasi sthitaḥ..6.4.57..
5.4.d:
त्वमपि प्राप्स्यसि श्रेयः परं हृदयसंस्थितम्.
ततोन्यदपि यत्किंचित्तत्रैव तपसि स्थितः..6.4.57..
5.4.m: You too will attain the supreme good that resides in your heart, / and whatever else [you desire] beyond that, fixed in austerity right there."

5.4.s:
sūta uvāca.
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā viśvāmitro munīśvaraḥ.
triśaṃkunā samāyukto gatastatra drutaṃ tataḥ..6.4.58..
5.4.d:
सूत उवाच.
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा विश्वामित्रो मुनीश्वरः.
त्रिशंकुना समायुक्तो गतस्तत्र द्रुतं ततः..6.4.58..
5.4.m: Sūta said: / Hearing that speech of his, the lord of sages, Viśvāmitra, / accompanied by Triśaṅku, went there swiftly from that place.

5.4.s:
pātāle devamārgeṇa praviśya nṛpasattamam.
triśaṃkuṃ snāpayāmāsa vidhidṛṣṭena karmaṇā..6.4.59..
5.4.d:
पाताले देवमार्गेण प्रविश्य नृपसत्तमम्.
त्रिशंकुं स्नापयामास विधिदृष्टेन कर्मणा..6.4.59..
5.4.m: Entering Pātāla by the divine path, / he had the best of kings, Triśaṅku, bathe according to prescribed rites.

5.4.s:
snātamātrotha rājā sa hāṭakeśvadarśanāt.
caṃḍālatvena nirmukto babhūvārkasamadyutiḥ..6.4.60..
5.4.d:
स्नातमात्रोथ राजा स हाटकेश्वदर्शनात्.
चंडालत्वेन निर्मुक्तो बभूवार्कसमद्युतिः..6.4.60..
5.4.m: As soon as he bathed, by the darśana of Hāṭakeśvara, / the king was liberated from the state of a caṇḍāla and became radiant as the sun.

5.4.s:
tatastaṃ sa muniḥ prāha praṇataṃ gatakalmaṣam.
diṣṭyā muktosi rājeṃdra caṃḍālatvena sāṃpratam..6.4.61..
5.4.d:
ततस्तं स मुनिः प्राह प्रणतं गतकल्मषम्.
दिष्ट्या मुक्तोसि राजेंद्र चंडालत्वेन सांप्रतम्..6.4.61..
5.4.m: Then the sage said to him, who bowed low, his impurities gone: / "By good fortune you have now been freed from the state of a caṇḍāla, O lord of kings!

5.4.s:
diṣṭyā prāptaḥ paraṃ tejo diṣṭyā prāptaḥ paraṃ tapaḥ.
tasmādyajasva satreṇa vidhivaddakṣiṇāvatā..6.4.62..
5.4.d:
दिष्ट्या प्राप्तः परं तेजो दिष्ट्या प्राप्तः परं तपः.
तस्माद्यजस्व सत्रेण विधिवद्दक्षिणावता..6.4.62..
5.4.m: By good fortune supreme splendor has been attained; by good fortune supreme austerity has been attained! / Therefore, perform a sacrifice with a sacrificial session according to the rules, accompanied by generous gifts,

5.4.s:
yena saṃprāpsyase siddhiṃ nityaṃ yā hṛdaye sthitā.
tvatkṛte prārthayiṣyāmi svayaṃ gatvā pitāmaham..6.4.63..
5.4.d:
येन संप्राप्स्यसे सिद्धिं नित्यं या हृदये स्थिता.
त्वत्कृते प्रार्थयिष्यामि स्वयं गत्वा पितामहम्..6.4.63..
5.4.m: by which you will attain the perfection that constantly resides in your heart. / For your sake, I myself will go and request the Grandfather,

5.4.s:
makhāṃśaṃ sarvadevādyo yena gṛhṇāti te makhe.
tasmādatraiva saṃbhārānsarvānyajñasamudbhavān.
ānaya brahmalokācca yāvadāgamanaṃ mama..6.4.64..
5.4.d:
मखांशं सर्वदेवाद्यो येन गृह्णाति ते मखे.
तस्मादत्रैव संभारान्सर्वान्यज्ञसमुद्भवान्.
आनय ब्रह्मलोकाच्च यावदागमनं मम..6.4.64..
5.4.m: so that the foremost of all the gods may take his share of the sacrifice in your rite. / Therefore, gather right here all the materials required for the sacrifice, / until my return from the realm of Brahmā."

5.4.s:
bāḍhamityeva so'pyāha sa muniḥ saṃśitavrataḥ.
pitāmahamupāgamya praṇipatyābravīdvacaḥ..6.4.65..
5.4.d:
बाढमित्येव सोऽप्याह स मुनिः संशितव्रतः.
पितामहमुपागम्य प्रणिपत्याब्रवीद्वचः..6.4.65..
5.4.m: "So be it," replied that sage of firm vows. / Approaching the Grandfather and bowing down, he spoke these words:

5.4.s:
yājayiṣyāmyahaṃ bhūpaṃ triśaṃkuṃ prapitāmaha.
mānuṣeṇa śarīreṇa yena gacchati te padam..6.4.66..
5.4.d:
याजयिष्याम्यहं भूपं त्रिशंकुं प्रपितामह.
मानुषेण शरीरेण येन गच्छति ते पदम्..6.4.66..
5.4.m: "I will officiate at a sacrifice for King Triśaṅku, O great-grandfather, / so that he may reach your abode in his mortal body.

5.4.s:
tasmādāgaccha tatra tvaṃ yajñavāṭaṃ pitāmaha.
sarvaiḥ suragaṇaiḥ sārdhaṃ śivaviṣṇupuraḥsaraiḥ..6.4.67..
5.4.d:
तस्मादागच्छ तत्र त्वं यज्ञवाटं पितामह.
सर्वैः सुरगणैः सार्धं शिवविष्णुपुरःसरैः..6.4.67..
5.4.m: Therefore, come there, O Grandfather, to the sacrificial enclosure, / along with all the hosts of gods, headed by Śiva and Viṣṇu.

5.4.s:
pragṛhāṇa svahastena yajñabhāgaṃ yathocitam.
saśarīro divaṃ yāti yenāsau tvatprasādataḥ..6.4.68..
5.4.d:
प्रगृहाण स्वहस्तेन यज्ञभागं यथोचितम्.
सशरीरो दिवं याति येनासौ त्वत्प्रसादतः..6.4.68..
5.4.m: Accept with your own hand the share of the sacrifice as is proper, / so that by your grace he may go to heaven in his bodily form."

5.4.s:
brahmovāca.
na yajñakarmaṇā svargaḥsvena kāyena labhyate.
muktvā dehāṃtaraṃ brahmaṃstasmānmaivaṃ vadasva mām..6.4.69..
5.4.d:
ब्रह्मोवाच.
न यज्ञकर्मणा स्वर्गःस्वेन कायेन लभ्यते.
मुक्त्वा देहांतरं ब्रह्मंस्तस्मान्मैवं वदस्व माम्..6.4.69..
5.4.m: Brahmā said: / "Heaven is not attained in one's own body by sacrificial action / without casting off another body, O brahmin; therefore, do not speak thus to me.

5.4.s:
vayamagnimukhāḥ sarve havirgṛhṇāmahe makhe.
vedoktavidhinā samyagyajamānahitāya vai..6.4.70..
5.4.d:
वयमग्निमुखाः सर्वे हविर्गृह्णामहे मखे.
वेदोक्तविधिना सम्यग्यजमानहिताय वै..6.4.70..
5.4.m: All of us, having fire as our mouth, accept the oblation in a sacrifice / properly according to the rite proclaimed in the Veda, truly for the benefit of the sacrificer.

5.4.s:
tasmādvahnimukhe bhūyaḥ sa juhoti havirdvija.
tataḥ saṃprāpsyati svargaṃ tvatprasādādasaṃśayam..6.4.71..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasrayāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye triśaṃkūpākhyāne viśvāmitrakṛtatriśaṃkuyājanopakramavarṇanaṃnāma caturtho'dhyāyaḥ..4..
5.4.d:
तस्माद्वह्निमुखे भूयः स जुहोति हविर्द्विज.
ततः संप्राप्स्यति स्वर्गं त्वत्प्रसादादसंशयम्..6.4.71..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्रयां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये त्रिशंकूपाख्याने विश्वामित्रकृतत्रिशंकुयाजनोपक्रमवर्णनंनाम चतुर्थोऽध्यायः..4..
5.4.m:
Therefore, let him again offer the oblation into the mouth of the fire, O twice-born one; / then, by your grace, he will attain heaven without a doubt."
Thus, in the holy Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, in the collection of eighty-one thousand [verses], in the sixth section, the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, in the glorification of the sacred field of Hāṭakeśvara, in the episode of Triśaṅku, ends the fourth chapter, entitled 'The Description of the Undertaking of the Sacrifice for Triśaṅku by Viśvāmitra.'

5.5.s:
sūta uvāca.
tacchrutvā brahmaṇo vākyaṃ viśvāmitro ruṣānvitaḥ.
pitāmahamuvācedaṃ paśya me tapaso balam..6.5.1..
5.5.d:
सूत उवाच.
तच्छ्रुत्वा ब्रह्मणो वाक्यं विश्वामित्रो रुषान्वितः.
पितामहमुवाचेदं पश्य मे तपसो बलम्..6.5.1..
5.5.m: Sūta said: / Hearing that statement of Brahmā, Viśvāmitra was filled with wrath. / He said this to the Grandfather: "Behold the power of my austerity!

5.5.s:
yājayitvā triśaṃkuṃ taṃ vidhivaddakṣiṇāvatā.
yajñenātrā(?) nayiṣyāmi paśyataste pitāmaha..6.5.2..
5.5.d:
याजयित्वा त्रिशंकुं तं विधिवद्दक्षिणावता.
यज्ञेनात्रा(?) नयिष्यामि पश्यतस्ते पितामह..6.5.2..
5.5.m: Having officiated at a sacrifice for Triśaṅku according to the rules, accompanied by generous gifts, / I will bring him here by means of that sacrifice, while you look on, O Grandfather!"

5.5.s:
evamuktvā drutaṃ gatvā viśvāmitro dharātalam.
cakāra yājane yatnaṃ triśaṃkoḥ sumahātmanaḥ..6.5.3..
5.5.d:
एवमुक्त्वा द्रुतं गत्वा विश्वामित्रो धरातलम्.
चकार याजने यत्नं त्रिशंकोः सुमहात्मनः..6.5.3..
5.5.m:
Having spoken thus and gone swiftly to the surface of the earth,
Viśvāmitra made an effort to perform the sacrifice for the great-souled Triśaṅku.

5.5.s:
dadau dīkṣāṃ samāhūya brāhmaṇānvedapāragān.
yatrakarmocite kāle tasminneva vane śubhe..6.5.4..
5.5.d:
ददौ दीक्षां समाहूय ब्राह्मणान्वेदपारगान्.
यत्रकर्मोचिते काले तस्मिन्नेव वने शुभे..6.5.4..
5.5.m:
Having summoned brahmins who had mastered the Vedas,
he administered the initiation at the time proper for the rite, in that very auspicious forest.

5.5.s:
babhūva sa svayaṃ dhīmānadhvaryuryajñakarmaṇi.
tasminhotā ca śāṃḍilyo brahmā gautama eva ca..6.5.5..
5.5.d:
बभूव स स्वयं धीमानध्वर्युर्यज्ञकर्मणि.
तस्मिन्होता च शांडिल्यो ब्रह्मा गौतम एव च..6.5.5..
5.5.m:
The wise sage himself became the adhvaryu priest in the sacrificial rite;
in it, Śāṇḍilya was the hotṛ, and Gautama was the brahmā.

5.5.s:
āgnīdhraścyavano nāma maitrāvaruṇaḥ kārmikaḥ.
udgātā yājñavalkyaśca pratihartā ca jaiminiḥ..6.5.6..
5.5.d:
आग्नीध्रश्च्यवनो नाम मैत्रावरुणः कार्मिकः.
उद्गाता याज्ञवल्क्यश्च प्रतिहर्ता च जैमिनिः..6.5.6..
5.5.m:
The āgnīdhra was named Cyavana; the active maitrāvaruṇa was [another];
Yājñavalkya was the udgātṛ, and Jaimini was the pratihartṛ.

5.5.s:
prastotā śaṃkuvarṇaśca tathonnetā ca gālavaḥ.
pulastyo brāhmaṇācchaṃsī hotā gargo munīśvaraḥ..6.5.7..
5.5.d:
प्रस्तोता शंकुवर्णश्च तथोन्नेता च गालवः.
पुलस्त्यो ब्राह्मणाच्छंसी होता गर्गो मुनीश्वरः..6.5.7..
5.5.m:
Śaṅkuvarṇa was the prastotṛ, and likewise Gālava was the unnetṛ;
Pulastya was the brāhmaṇācchaṃsin, and Garga, the lord of sages, was a hotṛ.

5.5.s:
neṣṭā caiva tathātristu acchāvāko bhṛguḥ svayam.
tānsarvānṛtvijaścakre triśaṃkuḥ śraddhayānvitaḥ..6.5.8..
5.5.d:
नेष्टा चैव तथात्रिस्तु अच्छावाको भृगुः स्वयम्.
तान्सर्वानृत्विजश्चक्रे त्रिशंकुः श्रद्धयान्वितः..6.5.8..
5.5.m:
Atri was the neṣṭṛ, and Bhṛgu himself was the acchāvāka.
Filled with faith, Triśaṅku appointed all of them as priests.

5.5.s:
vāsobhirmukuṭaiścaiva keyūraiḥ samalaṃkṛtān.
kṛtvā keśaparityāgaṃ dadhatkṛṣṇājinaṃ tathā..6.5.9..
5.5.d:
वासोभिर्मुकुटैश्चैव केयूरैः समलंकृतान्.
कृत्वा केशपरित्यागं दधत्कृष्णाजिनं तथा..6.5.9..
5.5.m:
They were adorned with garments, diadems, and armlets.
Having shaved his hair, wearing a black antelope skin,

5.5.s:
aiṇaśṛṅgasamāyuktaḥ payovrataparāyaṇaḥ.
dīrghasatrāya tānsarvānyojayāmāsa vai tataḥ..6.5.10..
5.5.d:
ऐणशृङ्गसमायुक्तः पयोव्रतपरायणः.
दीर्घसत्राय तान्सर्वान्योजयामास वै ततः..6.5.10..
5.5.m:
holding a blackbuck's horn, and devoted to the milk-fast vow,
he then engaged them all for the long sacrificial session.

5.5.s:
evaṃ tasminpravṛtte ca dīrghasatre yathocite.
ājagmurbrāhmaṇā divyā vedavedāṃgapāragāḥ..6.5.11..
5.5.d:
एवं तस्मिन्प्रवृत्ते च दीर्घसत्रे यथोचिते.
आजग्मुर्ब्राह्मणा दिव्या वेदवेदांगपारगाः..6.5.11..
5.5.m:
And when that long sacrificial session had begun in the proper manner,
celestial brahmins who had mastered the Vedas and Vedāṅgas arrived,

5.5.s:
tathānye tārkikāścaiva gṛhasthāḥ kautukānvitāḥ.
dīnāṃdhakṛpaṇāścaiva ye cānye naṭanartakāḥ..6.5.12..
5.5.d:
तथान्ये तार्किकाश्चैव गृहस्थाः कौतुकान्विताः.
दीनांधकृपणाश्चैव ये चान्ये नटनर्तकाः..6.5.12..
5.5.m:
as well as other logicians, curious householders,
the destitute, the blind, the wretched, and various actors and dancers.

5.5.s:
dīyatāṃ dīyatāmāśu eteṣāmetadeva hi.
bhujyatāṃbhujyatāṃ lokāḥ prasādaḥ kriyatāmiti..6.5.13..
5.5.d:
दीयतां दीयतामाशु एतेषामेतदेव हि.
भुज्यतांभुज्यतां लोकाः प्रसादः क्रियतामिति..6.5.13..
5.5.m:
“Let it be given, let it be given quickly to them!”—only this [was heard]:
“Eat, eat, O people! Partake of the favor!”

5.5.s:
ityeṣa ninadastatra śrūyate satataṃ mahān.
yajñavāṭe sadā tasminnānyaścaiva kadācana..6.5.14..
5.5.d:
इत्येष निनदस्तत्र श्रूयते सततं महान्.
यज्ञवाटे सदा तस्मिन्नान्यश्चैव कदाचन..6.5.14..
5.5.m:
Such a great clamor was constantly heard there
always in that sacrificial enclosure, and never anything else.

5.5.s:
tatra sasyamayāḥ śailā dṛśyaṃte parikalpitāḥ.
suvarṇasya ca rūpyasya ratnānāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ..6.5.15..
5.5.d:
तत्र सस्यमयाः शैला दृश्यंते परिकल्पिताः.
सुवर्णस्य च रूप्यस्य रत्नानां च विशेषतः..6.5.15..
5.5.m:
There, artificial mountains made of grain were seen,
and especially of gold, silver, and jewels,

5.5.s:
dānārthaṃ brāhmaṇeṃdrāṇāmasaṃkhyāścāpi dhenavaḥ.
tathaiva vājino dāṃtā madonmattā mahāgajāḥ..6.5.16..
5.5.d:
दानार्थं ब्राह्मणेंद्राणामसंख्याश्चापि धेनवः.
तथैव वाजिनो दांता मदोन्मत्ता महागजाः..6.5.16..
5.5.m:
for donation to the chief brahmins, as well as countless cows,
likewise tame horses, and rutting, great elephants

5.5.s:
samaṃtātkalpitāstatra dṛśyaṃte parvatopamāḥ.
vartamāne mahāyajñe tasminneva suvistare..6.5.17..
5.5.d:
समंतात्कल्पितास्तत्र दृश्यंते पर्वतोपमाः.
वर्तमाने महायज्ञे तस्मिन्नेव सुविस्तरे..6.5.17..
5.5.m:
arranged on all sides, resembling mountains, were seen there.
While that very extensive great sacrifice was proceeding,

5.5.s:
āhūtā yajñabhāgāya nābhigacchaṃti devatāḥ.
kevalaṃ vahnivaktreṇa tasya gṛhṇaṃti taddhaviḥ..6.5.18..
5.5.d:
आहूता यज्ञभागाय नाभिगच्छंति देवताः.
केवलं वह्निवक्त्रेण तस्य गृह्णंति तद्धविः..6.5.18..
5.5.m:
the deities, though summoned for their sacrificial share, did not approach;
they received his oblation solely through the mouth of the fire.

5.5.s:
evaṃ dvādaśavarṣāṇi yajatastasya bhūpateḥ.
vyatītāni na saṃprāptamabhīṣṭaṃ manasaḥ phalam..6.5.19..
5.5.d:
एवं द्वादशवर्षाणि यजतस्तस्य भूपतेः.
व्यतीतानि न संप्राप्तमभीष्टं मनसः फलम्..6.5.19..
5.5.m:
In this way twelve years passed for that king as he sacrificed,
yet the desired fruit of his heart was not obtained.

5.5.s:
tataścāvabhṛthasnānaṃ kṛtvā satrasamāptijam.
ṛtvijastarpayitvā tāndakṣiṇābhiryathārhataḥ..6.5.20..
5.5.d:
ततश्चावभृथस्नानं कृत्वा सत्रसमाप्तिजम्.
ऋत्विजस्तर्पयित्वा तान्दक्षिणाभिर्यथार्हतः..6.5.20..
5.5.m:
Then, having performed the purificatory bath that marks the end of a sacrificial session,
and having gratified the priests with fees according to their worth,

5.5.s:
visasarja samastāṃśca tathānyānapi saṃgatān.
saṃbaṃdhino vayasyāṃśca triśaṃkurmunisattamāḥ..6.5.21..
5.5.d:
विससर्ज समस्तांश्च तथान्यानपि संगतान्.
संबंधिनो वयस्यांश्च त्रिशंकुर्मुनिसत्तमाः..6.5.21..
5.5.m:
Triśaṅku dismissed all of them, as well as the others who had gathered,
his relatives and companions, O best of sages.

5.5.s:
tataḥ provāca vinato viśvāmitraṃ munīśvaram.
sa bhūpo vrīḍayā yuktaḥ praṇipātapuraḥ saram..6.5.22..
5.5.d:
ततः प्रोवाच विनतो विश्वामित्रं मुनीश्वरम्.
स भूपो व्रीडया युक्तः प्रणिपातपुरः सरम्..6.5.22..
5.5.m:
Then, humble and filled with embarrassment,
that king, bowing down before him, spoke to the lord of sages, Viśvāmitra:

5.5.s:
tvatprasādānmayā prāptaṃ dīrghasatrasamudbhavam.
paripūrṇaphalaṃ brahmandurlabhaṃ sarvamānavaiḥ..6.5.23..
5.5.d:
त्वत्प्रसादान्मया प्राप्तं दीर्घसत्रसमुद्भवम्.
परिपूर्णफलं ब्रह्मन्दुर्लभं सर्वमानवैः..6.5.23..
5.5.m:
“By your grace, O holy one, I have attained the complete fruit
arising from a long sacrificial session, which is difficult for all mortals to attain.

5.5.s:
tathā jātiḥ punarlabdhā bhūyo naṣṭāpi sanmune.
tvatprasādena viprarṣe caṃḍālatvaṃ praṇāśitam..6.5.24..
5.5.d:
तथा जातिः पुनर्लब्धा भूयो नष्टापि सन्मुने.
त्वत्प्रसादेन विप्रर्षे चंडालत्वं प्रणाशितम्..6.5.24..
5.5.m:
Likewise, my [original] caste was obtained once again, though it had been lost, O good sage;
by your grace, O brahmin-seer, the state of an outcaste was destroyed.

5.5.s:
paraṃ me duḥkhamevaikaṃ hṛdi śalyamivārpitam.
anenaiva śarīreṇa yanna prāptaṃ triviṣṭapam..6.5.25..
5.5.d:
परं मे दुःखमेवैकं हृदि शल्यमिवार्पितम्.
अनेनैव शरीरेण यन्न प्राप्तं त्रिविष्टपम्..6.5.25..
5.5.m:
Yet one single grief remains embedded in my heart like a dart:
that I have not reached heaven in this very body.

5.5.s:
upahāsaṃ kariṣyaṃti vasiṣṭhasya sutā mune.
adya vyartha śramaṃ śrutvā māmaprāptaṃ triviṣṭapam..6.5.26..
5.5.d:
उपहासं करिष्यंति वसिष्ठस्य सुता मुने.
अद्य व्यर्थ श्रमं श्रुत्वा मामप्राप्तं त्रिविष्टपम्..6.5.26..
5.5.m:
The sons of Vasiṣṭha will mock me, O sage,
when they hear today that my effort was useless and that I have not reached heaven.

5.5.s:
tathā tadvacanaṃ satyaṃ vasiṣṭhasya vyavasthitam.
yattenoktaṃ na yajñena sadehairgamyate divi..6.5.27..
5.5.d:
तथा तद्वचनं सत्यं वसिष्ठस्य व्यवस्थितम्.
यत्तेनोक्तं न यज्ञेन सदेहैर्गम्यते दिवि..6.5.27..
5.5.m:
Likewise, that statement of Vasiṣṭha stands proven true,
which he spoke: ‘One does not go to heaven with a physical body by means of a sacrifice.’

5.5.s:
so'haṃ tapaḥ kariṣyāmi sāṃprataṃ vanamāśritaḥ.
na kariṣyāmi bhūyo'pi rājyaṃ putraniveditam..6.5.28..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye triśaṃkūpākhyāne viśvāmitreṇa triśaṃkoḥ saśarīrasvargārohaṇāya dvādaśavārṣikayajñakaraṇaṃnāma pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ..5..
5.5.d:
सोऽहं तपः करिष्यामि सांप्रतं वनमाश्रितः.
न करिष्यामि भूयोऽपि राज्यं पुत्रनिवेदितम्..6.5.28..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये त्रिशंकूपाख्याने विश्वामित्रेण त्रिशंकोः सशरीरस्वर्गारोहणाय द्वादशवार्षिकयज्ञकरणंनाम पञ्चमोऽध्यायः..5..

5.6.s:
sūta uvāca.
tacchrutvā vacanaṃ tasya triśaṃkormunipuṃgavaḥ.
viśvāmitro'bravīdvākyaṃ kiṃcillajjāsamanvitaḥ..6.6.1..
5.6.d:
सूत उवाच.
तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं तस्य त्रिशंकोर्मुनिपुंगवः.
विश्वामित्रोऽब्रवीद्वाक्यं किंचिल्लज्जासमन्वितः..6.6.1..
5.6.m:
Sūta said:
Having heard those words of Triśaṅku, the eminent sage
Viśvāmitra, feeling somewhat ashamed, spoke these words:

5.6.s:
mā viṣādaṃ mahīpāla viṣaye'tra kariṣyasi.
anenaiva śarīreṇa tvāṃ nayiṣyāmyahaṃ divam..6.6.2..
5.6.d:
मा विषादं महीपाल विषयेऽत्र करिष्यसि.
अनेनैव शरीरेण त्वां नयिष्याम्यहं दिवम्..6.6.2..
5.6.m:
“Do not despair, O ruler of the earth, regarding this matter.
I shall bring you to heaven in this very body.

5.6.s:
tattatkarma kariṣyāmi svargārthe nṛpasattama.
tavābhīṣṭaṃ kariṣyāmi kiṃ vā yāsyāmi saṃkṣayam..6.6.3..
5.6.d:
तत्तत्कर्म करिष्यामि स्वर्गार्थे नृपसत्तम.
तवाभीष्टं करिष्यामि किं वा यास्यामि संक्षयम्..6.6.3..
5.6.m:
I will perform every necessary rite for the sake of heaven, O best of kings;
I will accomplish your desire, or else I shall perish.”

5.6.s:
evamuktvā paraṃ kopaṃ kṛtvopari divaukasām.
uvāca ca tato raudraṃ pratyakṣaṃ tasya bhūpateḥ..6.6.4..
5.6.d:
एवमुक्त्वा परं कोपं कृत्वोपरि दिवौकसाम्.
उवाच च ततो रौद्रं प्रत्यक्षं तस्य भूपतेः..6.6.4..
5.6.m:
Having spoken thus, displaying great anger against the dwellers of heaven,
he then spoke terrible words in the presence of that king:

5.6.s:
yathā mayā dvijatvaṃ hi svayamevārjitaṃ balāt.
tathā sṛṣṭiṃ kariṣyāmi svakīyāṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ..6.6.5..
5.6.d:
यथा मया द्विजत्वं हि स्वयमेवार्जितं बलात्.
तथा सृष्टिं करिष्यामि स्वकीयां नात्र संशयः..6.6.5..
5.6.m:
“Just as brahminhood was indeed acquired by me myself through my own power,
so shall I produce my own creation; of this there is no doubt.”

5.6.s:
tatastaṃ sa samālokya śaṃkaraṃ śaśiśekharam.
praṇamya vidhivadbhaktyā stutiṃ cakre mahāmuniḥ..6.6.6..
5.6.d:
ततस्तं स समालोक्य शंकरं शशिशेखरम्.
प्रणम्य विधिवद्भक्त्या स्तुतिं चक्रे महामुनिः..6.6.6..
5.6.m:
Then, having beheld Śaṃkara, who bears the crescent moon on his crest,
the great sage bowed down according to rule with devotion and offered praise.

5.6.s:
viśvāmitra uvāca.
jaya deva jayāciṃtya jaya pārvativallabha.
jaya kṛṣṇa jagannātha jaya kṛṣṇa jagadguro..6.6.7..
5.6.d:
विश्वामित्र उवाच.
जय देव जयाचिंत्य जय पार्वतिवल्लभ.
जय कृष्ण जगन्नाथ जय कृष्ण जगद्गुरो..6.6.7..
5.6.m:
Viśvāmitra said:
“Victory, O God! Victory, O Inconceivable One! Victory, O beloved of Pārvatī!
Victory, O Kṛṣṇa, Lord of the Universe! Victory, O Kṛṣṇa, Guru of the World!

5.6.s:
jayāciṃtya jayāmeya jayānaṃta jayācyuta.
jayāmara jayājeya jayāvyaya sureśvara..6.6.8..
5.6.d:
जयाचिंत्य जयामेय जयानंत जयाच्युत.
जयामर जयाजेय जयाव्यय सुरेश्वर..6.6.8..
5.6.m:
Victory, O Inconceivable One! Victory, O Immeasurable One! Victory, O Endless One! Victory, O Infallible One!
Victory, O Immortal One! Victory, O Unconquerable One! Victory, O Imperishable One, Lord of the Gods!

5.6.s:
jaya sarvaga sarveśa jaya sarvasurāśraya.
jaya sarvajanadhyeya jaya sarvāghanāśana..6.6.9..
5.6.d:
जय सर्वग सर्वेश जय सर्वसुराश्रय.
जय सर्वजनध्येय जय सर्वाघनाशन..6.6.9..
5.6.m:
Victory, O All-pervading One, Lord of All! Victory, O Refuge of All Gods!
Victory, O Goal of Meditation for All People! Victory, O Destroyer of All Sins!

5.6.s:
tvaṃ dhātā ca vidhātā ca tvaṃ kartā tvaṃ ca rakṣakaḥ.
caturvidhasya deveśa bhūtagrāmasya śaṃkara..6.6.10..
5.6.d:
त्वं धाता च विधाता च त्वं कर्ता त्वं च रक्षकः.
चतुर्विधस्य देवेश भूतग्रामस्य शंकर..6.6.10..
5.6.m:
You are the Creator and the Ordainer; you are the Maker and the Protector
of the fourfold realm of living beings, O Lord of Gods, O Śaṃkara.

5.6.s:
yathā tilasthitaṃ tailaṃ yathā dadhigataṃ ghṛtam.
tathaivādhiṣṭhitaṃ kṛtsnaṃ tvayā guptena vai jagat..6.6.11..
5.6.d:
यथा तिलस्थितं तैलं यथा दधिगतं घृतम्.
तथैवाधिष्ठितं कृत्स्नं त्वया गुप्तेन वै जगत्..6.6.11..
5.6.m:
Just as oil resides in sesame seeds, just as clarified butter resides in curds,
even so the entire universe is pervaded by you, concealed within it.

5.6.s:
tvaṃ brahmā tvaṃ hṛṣīkeśastvaṃ śakrastvaṃ hutāśanaḥ.
tvaṃ yajñastvaṃ vaṣaṭkārastvamindustvaṃ divākaraḥ..6.6.12..
5.6.d:
त्वं ब्रह्मा त्वं हृषीकेशस्त्वं शक्रस्त्वं हुताशनः.
त्वं यज्ञस्त्वं वषट्कारस्त्वमिन्दुस्त्वं दिवाकरः..6.6.12..
5.6.m:
You are Brahmā, you are Hṛṣīkeśa, you are Indra, you are the Fire;
you are the sacrifice, you are the vaṣaṭ-call, you are the moon, you are the sun.

5.6.s:
athavā bahunoktena kiṃ stavena tava prabho.
samāsādeva vakṣyāmi vibhūtiṃ śrutinoditām..6.6.13..
5.6.d:
अथवा बहुनोक्तेन किं स्तवेन तव प्रभो.
समासादेव वक्ष्यामि विभूतिं श्रुतिनोदिताम्..6.6.13..
5.6.m:
Or rather, what is the use of a lengthy hymn of praise for you, O Lord?
In brief alone shall I declare your manifestation as taught in the revealed scripture.

5.6.s:
yatkiṃcittriṣu lokeṣu sthāvaraṃ jaṃgamaṃ vibho.
tatsarvaṃ bhavatā vyāptaṃ kāṣṭhaṃ havyabhujā yathā..6.6.14..
5.6.d:
यत्किंचित्त्रिषु लोकेषु स्थावरं जंगमं विभो.
तत्सर्वं भवता व्याप्तं काष्ठं हव्यभुजा यथा..6.6.14..
5.6.m:
Whatever there is in the three worlds, stationary or moving, O All-pervading One,
all that is pervaded by you, as wood is by the consumer of oblations.”

5.6.s:
śrībhagavānuvāca.
parituṣṭo'smi bhadraṃ te varaṃ prārthaya sanmune.
yatte hṛdi sthitaṃ nityaṃ sarvaṃ dāsyāmyasaṃśayam..6.6.15..
5.6.d:
श्रीभगवानुवाच.
परितुष्टोऽस्मि भद्रं ते वरं प्रार्थय सन्मुने.
यत्ते हृदि स्थितं नित्यं सर्वं दास्याम्यसंशयम्..6.6.15..

5.6.s:
viśvāmitra uvāca.
yadi tuṣṭosi deveśa yadi deyo varo mama.
tanme syātsṛṣṭimāhātmyaṃ tvatprasādānmaheśvara..6.6.16..
5.6.d:
विश्वामित्र उवाच.
यदि तुष्टोसि देवेश यदि देयो वरो मम.
तन्मे स्यात्सृष्टिमाहात्म्यं त्वत्प्रसादान्महेश्वर..6.6.16..
5.6.m:
Viśvāmitra said:
“If you are pleased, O Lord of Gods, if a boon is to be given to me,
then may the power of creation be mine by your grace, O Maheśvara!”

5.6.s:
evamastviti taṃ coktvā bhagavānvṛṣabhadhvajaḥ.
sarvairgaṇaiḥ samāyuktastataścādarśanaṃ gataḥ..6.6.17..
5.6.d:
एवमस्त्विति तं चोक्त्वा भगवान्वृषभध्वजः.
सर्वैर्गणैः समायुक्तस्ततश्चादर्शनं गतः..6.6.17..
5.6.m: Saying to him, “So be it,” the blessed lord whose banner bears the bull, / accompanied by all his attendants, then vanished from sight.

5.6.s:
viśvāmitro'pi tatraiva sthito dhyānaparāyaṇaḥ.
cakre caturvidhāṃ sṛṣṭiṃ sparddhayā haṃsagāminaḥ..6.6.18..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvakṣetramāhātmye triśaṃkūpākhyāne viśvāmitravaralabdhirnāma ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ..6..
5.6.d:
विश्वामित्रोऽपि तत्रैव स्थितो ध्यानपरायणः.
चक्रे चतुर्विधां सृष्टिं स्पर्द्धया हंसगामिनः..6.6.18..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे हाटकेश्वक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये त्रिशंकूपाख्याने विश्वामित्रवरलब्धिर्नाम षष्ठोऽध्यायः..6..
5.6.m:
Viśvāmitra too, remaining right there, devoted to meditation, / fashioned the fourfold creation in rivalry with [Brahmā] whose vehicle is a swan.
Thus ends the sixth chapter, named “Attainment of the Boon by Viśvāmitra,” in the story of Triśaṅku in the māhātmya of the sacred field of Hāṭakeśvara, in the sixth Nāgarakhaṇḍa of the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand [verses].

5.7.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
evaṃ dhyāyamānena jalamāviśya kāmyayā ..
sṛṣṭaṃ saṃdhyādvayaṃ tacca dṛśyate'dyāpi vai dvijāḥ .. 1 ..
5.7.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
एवं ध्यायमानेन जलमाविश्य काम्यया ..
सृष्टं संध्याद्वयं तच्च दृश्यतेऽद्यापि वै द्विजाः .. 1 ..
5.7.m: Sūta said: / As he thus meditated, having entered the water with desire [in his heart], / the twin twilights were created, and they are seen even today, O brahmins.

5.7.s:
tato devagaṇāḥ sarve sṛṣṭāstena mahātmanā ..
vaimānikāśca ye kecinnakṣatrāṇi grahāstathā .. 2 ..
5.7.d:
ततो देवगणाः सर्वे सृष्टास्तेन महात्मना ..
वैमानिकाश्च ये केचिन्नक्षत्राणि ग्रहास्तथा .. 2 ..
5.7.m: Then all the hosts of gods were created by that great-souled one, / and whichever gods ride celestial chariots, as well as the asterisms and the planets,

5.7.s:
manuṣyoragarakṣāṃsi vīrudho vṛkṣasaṃyutāḥ ..
saptarṣayo dhruvādyāśca ye cānye gaganecarāḥ .. 3 ..
5.7.d:
मनुष्योरगरक्षांसि वीरुधो वृक्षसंयुताः ..
सप्तर्षयो ध्रुवाद्याश्च ये चान्ये गगनेचराः .. 3 ..
5.7.m: humans, serpents, and rākṣasas; creeping plants together with trees; / the Seven Seers, Dhruva and the others, and whatever other wanderers of the sky [there are].

5.7.s:
evaṃ hi bhagavānsṛṣṭvā viśvāmitraḥ sa manyumān ..
svakīyeṣvatha kṛtyeṣu yojayāmāsa tāṃstataḥ .. 4 ..
5.7.d:
एवं हि भगवान्सृष्ट्वा विश्वामित्रः स मन्युमान् ..
स्वकीयेष्वथ कृत्येषु योजयामास तांस्ततः .. 4 ..
5.7.m: Having thus created [them], the wrathful lord Viśvāmitra / then appointed them to their respective functions.

5.7.s:
etasminneva kāle tu dvau sūryo yugapaddivi ..
uditau rātrināthau ca jātāśca dviguṇā grahāḥ ..
dviguṇāni ca bhānyeva saha saptarṣibhirdvijāḥ .. 5 ..
5.7.d:
एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु द्वौ सूर्यो युगपद्दिवि ..
उदितौ रात्रिनाथौ च जाताश्च द्विगुणा ग्रहाः ..
द्विगुणानि च भान्येव सह सप्तर्षिभिर्द्विजाः .. 5 ..
5.7.m: At that very time, two suns simultaneously in the sky / and two lords of the night (moons) arose, and the planets became doubled, / and the asterisms too became doubled, together with the Seven Seers, O brahmins.

5.7.s:
evaṃ viyati te sarve sparddhamānāḥ parasparam ..
dṛśyaṃte dviguṇībhūtā janavibhramakārakāḥ .. 6 ..
5.7.d:
एवं वियति ते सर्वे स्पर्द्धमानाः परस्परम् ..
दृश्यंते द्विगुणीभूता जनविभ्रमकारकाः .. 6 ..
5.7.m: Thus in the sky they were all seen doubled, / vying with one another and causing bewilderment among people.

5.7.s:
etasminnantare śakraḥ saha sarverdivālayaiḥ ..
jagāma tatra yatrāste bhagavānkamalāsanaḥ .. 7
5.7.d:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे शक्रः सह सर्वेर्दिवालयैः ..
जगाम तत्र यत्रास्ते भगवान्कमलासनः .. 7
5.7.m: Meanwhile, Śakra, together with all the dwellers of heaven, / went to the place where the blessed one seated on the lotus resided.

5.7.s:
provācātha praṇamyoccaiḥ kṛtāṃjalipuṭaḥ sthitaḥ ..
stutiṃ kṛtvā suraiḥ sārdhaṃ vedoktaiḥ stavanairdvijāḥ .. 8 ..
5.7.d:
प्रोवाचाथ प्रणम्योच्चैः कृतांजलिपुटः स्थितः ..
स्तुतिं कृत्वा सुरैः सार्धं वेदोक्तैः स्तवनैर्द्विजाः .. 8 ..
5.7.m: Then, having bowed low and standing with folded hands, / having offered praise together with the gods using praises declared in the Vedas, O brahmins, he spoke:

5.7.s:
sṛṣṭiḥ kṛtā suraśreṣṭha viśvāmitreṇa sāṃpratam ..
manuṣyayakṣasarpāṇāṃ devagaṃdharvarakṣasām .. 9 ..
5.7.d:
सृष्टिः कृता सुरश्रेष्ठ विश्वामित्रेण सांप्रतम् ..
मनुष्ययक्षसर्पाणां देवगंधर्वरक्षसाम् .. 9 ..
5.7.m: “A creation has now been made by Viśvāmitra, O best of gods, / of humans, yakṣas, serpents, gods, gandharvas, and rākṣasas.

5.7.s:
tasmādvāraya taṃ gatvā svayameva pitāmaha ..
yāvanna vyāpyate sarvaṃ tatsaṣṭyedaṃ carācaram .. 10
5.7.d:
तस्माद्वारय तं गत्वा स्वयमेव पितामह ..
यावन्न व्याप्यते सर्वं तत्सष्ट्येदं चराचरम् .. 10
5.7.m: Therefore, go yourself and restrain him, O Grandfather, / before all this movable and immovable world is overrun by his creation.”

5.7.s:
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā tenaiva sahito vidhiḥ ..
gatvovāca jaganmitraṃ viśvāmitraṃ munīśvaram .. 11 ..
5.7.d:
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा तेनैव सहितो विधिः ..
गत्वोवाच जगन्मित्रं विश्वामित्रं मुनीश्वरम् .. 11 ..
5.7.m: Hearing his word, the Ordainer (Brahmā), accompanied by him, / went and said to Viśvāmitra, the friend of the universe and lord of sages:

5.7.s:
nivṛttiṃ kuru viprarṣe sāṃprataṃ vacanānmama ..
sṛṣṭairyāvanna naśyaṃti sarve devāḥ savāsavāḥ .. 12 .. ..
5.7.d:
निवृत्तिं कुरु विप्रर्षे सांप्रतं वचनान्मम ..
सृष्टैर्यावन्न नश्यंति सर्वे देवाः सवासवाः .. 12 .. ..
5.7.m: “Desist now at my word, O brahmin-seer, / before all the gods, along with Indra, are destroyed by those who have been created.”

5.7.s:
viśvāmitra uvāca .. ..
anenaiva śarīreṇa triśaṃkurnṛpasattamaḥ..
yadi gacchati te loke tatsṛṣṭiṃ na karomyaham .. 13 ..
5.7.d:
विश्वामित्र उवाच .. ..
अनेनैव शरीरेण त्रिशंकुर्नृपसत्तमः..
यदि गच्छति ते लोके तत्सृष्टिं न करोम्यहम् .. 13 ..
5.7.m: Viśvāmitra said: / “If Triśaṅku, the best of kings, goes to your realm / with this very body, then I shall not create.”

5.7.s:
.. brahmovāca .. ..
eṣa gacchatu bhūpālo mayā saha triviṣṭapam ..
anenaiva śarīreṇa tvatprasādānmunīśvara .. 14
5.7.d:
.. ब्रह्मोवाच .. ..
एष गच्छतु भूपालो मया सह त्रिविष्टपम् ..
अनेनैव शरीरेण त्वत्प्रसादान्मुनीश्वर .. 14
5.7.m: Brahmā said: / “Let this ruler of the earth go to heaven with me / in this very body, through your grace, O lord of sages.

5.7.s:
virāmaṃ kuru sṛṣṭestvaṃ naitadanyaḥ kariṣyati ..
na kṛtaṃ kenacilloke tatkarma bhavatā kṛtam.. 15 ..
.. viśvāmitra uvāca .. ..
yanmayā kopayuktena kṛteyaṃ sṛṣṭirabjaja ..
tatkṣatavyaṃ tvayā deva sarvalokapitāmaha ...6..
5.7.d:
विरामं कुरु सृष्टेस्त्वं नैतदन्यः करिष्यति ..
न कृतं केनचिल्लोके तत्कर्म भवता कृतम्.. 15 ..
.. विश्वामित्र उवाच .. ..
यन्मया कोपयुक्तेन कृतेयं सृष्टिरब्जज ..
तत्क्षतव्यं त्वया देव सर्वलोकपितामह ...6..
5.7.m:
Put an end to your creating; no one else will do this. / What has not been done by anyone in the world, that deed has been done by you.”
Viśvāmitra said: / “That this creation was made by me filled with anger, O lotus-born one, / that must be pardoned by you, O god, Grandfather of all the worlds.

5.7.s:
tathā'kṣayāstu me deva sṛṣṭistava prasādataḥ ..
yā kṛtā na kariṣyāmi bhūyo 'nyāṃ padmasaṃbhava .. 17 ..
5.7.d:
तथाऽक्षयास्तु मे देव सृष्टिस्तव प्रसादतः ..
या कृता न करिष्यामि भूयो ऽन्यां पद्मसंभव .. 17 ..
5.7.m: Furthermore, O god, by your grace let my creation / that has been made be imperishable; I shall not fashion another, O lotus-born one.”

5.7.s:
.. vrahmovāca .. ..
bhaviṣyati dhruvā vipra sṛṣṭiryā bhavatā kṛtā ..
paraṃ sarveṣu kṛtyeṣu yajñārhā na bhaviṣyati .. 18 .. ???
5.7.d:
.. व्रह्मोवाच .. ..
भविष्यति ध्रुवा विप्र सृष्टिर्या भवता कृता ..
परं सर्वेषु कृत्येषु यज्ञार्हा न भविष्यति .. 18 .. ???
5.7.m: Brahmā said: / “The creation which has been made by you, O brahmin, shall be permanent; / however, in all rites it shall not be fit for sacrifice.”

5.7.s:
evamuktvā samādāya triśaṃkuṃ prapitāmahaḥ ..
brahmalokaṃ gato hṛṣṭo munistatraiva saṃsthitaḥ .. 19 ..
iti skānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhenāgarakhaṃḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye triśaṃkūpākhyāne triśaṃkusvargaprāptivarṇanaṃnāma saptamo'dhyāyaḥ ..7.. ..9..
5.7.d:
एवमुक्त्वा समादाय त्रिशंकुं प्रपितामहः ..
ब्रह्मलोकं गतो हृष्टो मुनिस्तत्रैव संस्थितः .. 19 ..
इति स्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठेनागरखंडे हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये त्रिशंकूपाख्याने त्रिशंकुस्वर्गप्राप्तिवर्णनंनाम सप्तमोऽध्यायः ..7.. ..9..
5.7.m:
Having spoken thus and taken Triśaṅku, the Great-Grandfather, / delighted, went to the realm of Brahmā; the sage remained right there.
Thus ends the seventh chapter, named “Description of Triśaṅku's Attainment of Heaven,” in the story of Triśaṅku in the māhātmya of the sacred field of Hāṭakeśvara, in the sixth Nāgarakhaṇḍa of the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand [verses].

5.8.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
evaṃ svargamanuprāpte triśaṃkau nṛpasattame ..
saśarīre dvijaśreṣṭhā viśvāmitrasamudyamāt .. 6.8.1 ..
5.8.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
एवं स्वर्गमनुप्राप्ते त्रिशंकौ नृपसत्तमे ..
सशरीरे द्विजश्रेष्ठा विश्वामित्रसमुद्यमात् .. 6.8.1 ..
5.8.m: Sūta said: / When Triśaṅku, the best of kings, had thus reached heaven / in bodily form through the exertion of Viśvāmitra, O best of brahmins,

5.8.s:
tattīrthaṃ khyātimāyātaṃ samaste bhuvanatraye ..
tataḥprasūti lokānāṃ dharmakāmārthamokṣadam .. 2 ..
5.8.d:
तत्तीर्थं ख्यातिमायातं समस्ते भुवनत्रये ..
ततःप्रसूति लोकानां धर्मकामार्थमोक्षदम् .. 2 ..
5.8.m: that sacred ford attained renown throughout the three worlds; / from then on, it bestowed upon people righteousness, desire, wealth, and liberation.

5.8.s:
aspṛṣṭaṃ kalidoṣeṇa tathānyairupapātakaiḥ ..
brahmahatyādikaiścaivatripurāreḥ prabhāvataḥ .. 3 ..
5.8.d:
अस्पृष्टं कलिदोषेण तथान्यैरुपपातकैः ..
ब्रह्महत्यादिकैश्चैवत्रिपुरारेः प्रभावतः .. 3 ..
5.8.m: It was untouched by the flaw of the Kali age, as well as by other secondary sins / and by the slaying of a brahmin and the like, through the power of the enemy of Tripura (Śiva).

5.8.s:
yastatra tyajati prāṇāñchraddhā yuktena cetasā ..
sa mokṣamāpnuyānmartyo yadyapi syātsupāpakṛt .. 4 ..
5.8.d:
यस्तत्र त्यजति प्राणाञ्छ्रद्धा युक्तेन चेतसा ..
स मोक्षमाप्नुयान्मर्त्यो यद्यपि स्यात्सुपापकृत् .. 4 ..
5.8.m: Whoever abandons his vital breaths there with a mind endowed with faith, / that mortal attains liberation, even though he might be a perpetrator of grave sins.

5.8.s:
kṛmipakṣipataṃgā ye paśavaḥ pakṣiṇo mṛgāḥ ..
te'pi tatra mṛtā yāṃti śivalokamasaṃśayam.. 5 ..
5.8.d:
कृमिपक्षिपतंगा ये पशवः पक्षिणो मृगाः ..
तेऽपि तत्र मृता यांति शिवलोकमसंशयम्.. 5 ..
5.8.m: Worms, birds, winged insects, beasts, fowl, and deer— / even they, dying there, go to the realm of Śiva without doubt.

5.8.s:
snānaṃ ye tatra kurvaṃti śraddhāpūtena cetasā ..
triśaṃkuriva te svarge prayāṃtyapi vidharmiṇaḥ .. 6 ..
5.8.d:
स्नानं ये तत्र कुर्वंति श्रद्धापूतेन चेतसा ..
त्रिशंकुरिव ते स्वर्गे प्रयांत्यपि विधर्मिणः .. 6 ..
5.8.m: Those who perform their ritual ablution there with a mind purified by faith, / even if devoid of righteousness, go to heaven just like Triśaṅku.

5.8.s:
gharmārttā vā tṛṣārtā vā ye'vagāhaṃti tajjalam..
te'pi yāṃti paraṃ sthānaṃ yatra devo maheśvaraḥ .. 7 ..
5.8.d:
घर्मार्त्ता वा तृषार्ता वा येऽवगाहंति तज्जलम्..
तेऽपि यांति परं स्थानं यत्र देवो महेश्वरः .. 7 ..
5.8.m: Or those oppressed by heat or thirst who plunge into its water, / they too go to the supreme abode where the divine Maheśvara resides.

5.8.s:
viśvāmitro'pi taddṛṣṭvā tīrthamāhātmyamuttamam ..
kurukṣetraṃ parityajya tatra vāsamathākarot.. 8 ..
5.8.d:
विश्वामित्रोऽपि तद्दृष्ट्वा तीर्थमाहात्म्यमुत्तमम् ..
कुरुक्षेत्रं परित्यज्य तत्र वासमथाकरोत्.. 8 ..
5.8.m: Viśvāmitra too, seeing that supreme māhātmya of the sacred ford, / abandoned Kurukṣetra and then made his dwelling there.

5.8.s:
tathānye munayaḥ śāṃtāstyaktvā tīrthāni dūrataḥ..
tatrāśramapadaṃ kṛtvā prayātāḥ paramaṃ padam .. 9 ..
5.8.d:
तथान्ये मुनयः शांतास्त्यक्त्वा तीर्थानि दूरतः..
तत्राश्रमपदं कृत्वा प्रयाताः परमं पदम् .. 9 ..
5.8.m: Likewise, other tranquil sages, having abandoned sacred fords from afar / and made their hermitage there, attained the supreme state.

5.8.s:
tathaiva manujāḥ sarve dūrādāgatya satvarāḥ ..
tatra snātvā divaṃ yāṃti kṛtvā pāpaśatānyapi .. 6.8.10 ..
5.8.d:
तथैव मनुजाः सर्वे दूरादागत्य सत्वराः ..
तत्र स्नात्वा दिवं यांति कृत्वा पापशतान्यपि .. 6.8.10 ..
5.8.m: In the same way, all humans, coming quickly from afar, / bathing there, go to heaven even after committing hundreds of sins.

5.8.s:
evaṃ tasya prabhāveṇa tīrthasya dvijasattamāḥ ..
gacchamāneṣu lokeṣu sukhena tridivālayam .. 11 ..
5.8.d:
एवं तस्य प्रभावेण तीर्थस्य द्विजसत्तमाः ..
गच्छमानेषु लोकेषु सुखेन त्रिदिवालयम् .. 11 ..
5.8.m: Thus, through the power of that sacred ford, O best of brahmins, / as people were easily going to the abode of the thirty [gods] (heaven),

5.8.s:
agniṣṭomādikā sarvāḥ samucchedaṃ gatāḥ kriyāḥ ..
na kaścidyajate martyo na vrataṃ kurute naraḥ .. 12 ..
5.8.d:
अग्निष्टोमादिका सर्वाः समुच्छेदं गताः क्रियाः ..
न कश्चिद्यजते मर्त्यो न व्रतं कुरुते नरः .. 12 ..
5.8.m: all rites such as the Agniṣṭoma went to ruin; / no mortal sacrificed, and no man undertook a vow,

5.8.s:
na yacchati tathā dānaṃ na ca tīrthaṃ niṣevate ..
kevalaṃ kurute snānaṃ liṃgabhede samāhitaḥ .. 13 ..
5.8.d:
न यच्छति तथा दानं न च तीर्थं निषेवते ..
केवलं कुरुते स्नानं लिंगभेदे समाहितः .. 13 ..
5.8.m: nor did he give gifts, nor did he resort to [other] sacred fords; / he merely performed his ritual ablution at the Liṅgabheda with a concentrated mind,

5.8.s: tataḥ pragacchati svargaṃ vimānavaramāśritaḥ .. 14 ..
5.8.d: ततः प्रगच्छति स्वर्गं विमानवरमाश्रितः .. 14 ..
5.8.m: and then went forth to heaven, mounted upon an excellent aerial chariot.

5.8.s:
tataḥ prapūritāḥ sarve svargalokā narairdvijāḥ ..
brahmaviṣṇuśivendrādīnspardhamānaiḥ surottamān .. 15 ..
5.8.d:
ततः प्रपूरिताः सर्वे स्वर्गलोका नरैर्द्विजाः ..
ब्रह्मविष्णुशिवेन्द्रादीन्स्पर्धमानैः सुरोत्तमान् .. 15 ..
5.8.m: Then, O brahmins, all the heavenly realms became packed with men / vying with the foremost gods—Brahmā, Viṣṇu, Śiva, Indra, and the rest.

5.8.s:
tato devagaṇāḥ sarve yajñabhāgavivarjitāḥ ..
kṛcchraṃ paramanuprāptā mantraṃ cakruḥ parasparam..16..
5.8.d:
ततो देवगणाः सर्वे यज्ञभागविवर्जिताः ..
कृच्छ्रं परमनुप्राप्ता मन्त्रं चक्रुः परस्परम्..16..
5.8.m: Then all the hosts of gods, deprived of their shares in the sacrifice / and plunged into extreme distress, held counsel with one another:

5.8.s:
hāṭakeśvaramāhātmyātsvargalokaḥ prapūritaḥ ..
ūrdhvabāhubhirākīrṇaḥ spardhamānaiḥ samaṃtataḥ .. 17 ..
5.8.d:
हाटकेश्वरमाहात्म्यात्स्वर्गलोकः प्रपूरितः ..
ऊर्ध्वबाहुभिराकीर्णः स्पर्धमानैः समंततः .. 17 ..
5.8.m: “Through the māhātmya of Hāṭakeśvara, the world of heaven is packed full, / crowded on all sides with men with raised arms vying [with us].

5.8.s:
tasmāttatkriyatāṃ karma yenocchedaṃ pragacchati ..
tīrthameddharāpṛṣṭhe hāṭakeśvarasaṃjñitam.. 18 ..
5.8.d:
तस्मात्तत्क्रियतां कर्म येनोच्छेदं प्रगच्छति ..
तीर्थमेद्धरापृष्ठे हाटकेश्वरसंज्ञितम्.. 18 ..
5.8.m: Therefore, let that deed be done by which that sacred ford / named Hāṭakeśvara on the face of the earth goes to destruction.”

5.8.s:
tataḥ saṃvartako vāyuḥ śakrādeśātsamaṃtataḥ ..
tatkṣetraṃ pūrayāmāsa pāṃsubhirdvijasattamāḥ .. 19 ..
5.8.d:
ततः संवर्तको वायुः शक्रादेशात्समंततः ..
तत्क्षेत्रं पूरयामास पांसुभिर्द्विजसत्तमाः .. 19 ..
5.8.m: Thereupon, at the command of Śakra, the dissolutive wind on all sides / filled that sacred field with dust, O best of brahmins.

5.8.s:
evaṃ nāśamanuprāpte tasmiṃstīrthe sthaloccaye ..
jāte jātāḥ kriyāḥ sarvā bhūyo'pi kratusaṃbhavāḥ .. 6.8.20 ..
5.8.d:
एवं नाशमनुप्राप्ते तस्मिंस्तीर्थे स्थलोच्चये ..
जाते जाताः क्रियाः सर्वा भूयोऽपि क्रतुसंभवाः .. 6.8.20 ..
5.8.m: When that sacred ford was thus destroyed and elevated ground was formed, / all the sacrificial rites were performed once again.

5.8.s:
tataḥ kālena mahatā valmīkaḥ samapadyata ..
tasminkṣetre sa pātāle saṃprayātaḥ śanaiḥśanaiḥ .. 21 ..
5.8.d:
ततः कालेन महता वल्मीकः समपद्यत ..
तस्मिन्क्षेत्रे स पाताले संप्रयातः शनैःशनैः .. 21 ..
5.8.m: Then, after a great length of time, an anthill formed / in that sacred field, which gradually reached down to Pātāla.

5.8.s:
atha pātālato nāgāstena mārgeṇa kautukāt ..
martyalokaṃ samāyāṃti bhramaṃti ca dharātale..22..
5.8.d:
अथ पातालतो नागास्तेन मार्गेण कौतुकात् ..
मर्त्यलोकं समायांति भ्रमंति च धरातले..22..
5.8.m: Then the nāgas, out of curiosity, along that path from Pātāla / would come to the world of mortals and wander upon the surface of the earth.

5.8.s:
tatra te mānavānbhogānbhuktvā caiva yathecchayā..
punarniryāṃti tenaiva mārgeṇa nijamaṃdiram..23..
5.8.d:
तत्र ते मानवान्भोगान्भुक्त्वा चैव यथेच्छया..
पुनर्निर्यांति तेनैव मार्गेण निजमंदिरम्..23..
5.8.m: Having enjoyed human pleasures there to their heart's content, / they would depart again by that very path to their own abode.

5.8.s:
tato nāgabilaḥ khyātaḥ sa sarvasmindharātale ..
gatāgatena nāgānāṃ sa valmīko dvijottamāḥ .. 24 ..
5.8.d:
ततो नागबिलः ख्यातः स सर्वस्मिन्धरातले ..
गतागतेन नागानां स वल्मीको द्विजोत्तमाः .. 24 ..
5.8.m: Therefore, O best of brahmins, that anthill became known all over the earth / as the 'nāga-hole' due to the coming and going of the nāgas.

5.8.s:
kasyacittvatha kālasya bhagavānpākaśāsanaḥ ..
brahmahatyāsamopeto nistejāḥ samapadyata .. 25 ..
5.8.d:
कस्यचित्त्वथ कालस्य भगवान्पाकशासनः ..
ब्रह्महत्यासमोपेतो निस्तेजाः समपद्यत .. 25 ..
5.8.m: Then, at a certain time, the blessed Indra (Pākaśāsana), / seized by the sin of killing a brahmin, lost his luster.

5.8.s:
tataḥ pitāmahādeśaṃ labdhvā mārgeṇa tena saḥ ..
praviśya cekṣayāmāsa pātāle hāṭa keśvaram .. 26 ..
5.8.d:
ततः पितामहादेशं लब्ध्वा मार्गेण तेन सः ..
प्रविश्य चेक्षयामास पाताले हाट केश्वरम् .. 26 ..
5.8.m: Then, having received an instruction from the Grandfather [Brahmā], he entered / by that path and beheld Hāṭakeśvara in Pātāla.

5.8.s:
athā'bhūtpāpanirmuktastatkṣaṇāttasya darśanāt..
tejasā ca samāyuktaḥ punaḥ prāpa triviṣṭapam .. 27 ..
5.8.d:
अथाऽभूत्पापनिर्मुक्तस्तत्क्षणात्तस्य दर्शनात्..
तेजसा च समायुक्तः पुनः प्राप त्रिविष्टपम् .. 27 ..
5.8.m: Then, from the darśana of him, he was instantly freed from sin, / and endowed once more with splendor, he returned to heaven.

5.8.s:
sa dṛṣṭvā tatprabhāvaṃ talliṃgaṃ devasya śūlinaḥ ..
hāṭakeśvarasaṃjñasya bhayaṃ cakre narodbhavam .. 28 ..
5.8.d:
स दृष्ट्वा तत्प्रभावं तल्लिंगं देवस्य शूलिनः ..
हाटकेश्वरसंज्ञस्य भयं चक्रे नरोद्भवम् .. 28 ..
5.8.m: Having witnessed the power of that liṅga of the trident-bearing god / named Hāṭakeśvara, he conceived a fear arising from human beings:

5.8.s:
yadi kaścitpumānatra triśaṃkuriva bhūpatiḥ ..
pūjayiṣyati talliṃgaṃ vipāpmā śraddhayā saha .. 29 ..
5.8.d:
यदि कश्चित्पुमानत्र त्रिशंकुरिव भूपतिः ..
पूजयिष्यति तल्लिंगं विपाप्मा श्रद्धया सह .. 29 ..
5.8.m: "If some man here, like King Triśaṅku, / freed of sin, should worship that liṅga with faith,

5.8.s:
yāpayiṣyati tannūnaṃ māmasmāttridaśālayāt ..
tasmātsaṃpūrayāmyenaṃ mārgaṃ pātā lasaṃbhavam .. 6.8.30 ..
5.8.d:
यापयिष्यति तन्नूनं मामस्मात्त्रिदशालयात् ..
तस्मात्संपूरयाम्येनं मार्गं पाता लसंभवम् .. 6.8.30 ..
5.8.m: he will surely displace me from this abode of the gods. / Therefore, I shall fill up this path leading to Pātāla."

5.8.s:
tataśca tvarayā yukto raktaśṛṃgaṃ nagottamam ..
pracikṣepa bile tasminsvayameva śatakratuḥ .. 31 ..
5.8.d:
ततश्च त्वरया युक्तो रक्तशृंगं नगोत्तमम् ..
प्रचिक्षेप बिले तस्मिन्स्वयमेव शतक्रतुः .. 31 ..
5.8.m: Then, filled with haste, Indra (Śatakratu) himself / hurled the excellent mountain Raktaśṛṅga into that hole.

5.8.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .... .. ..
brahmahatyā kathaṃ jātā devendrasya mahātmanaḥ ..
kasminkāle ca sarvaṃ no vistarātsūta kīrtaya .. 32 ..
5.8.d:
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .... .. ..
ब्रह्महत्या कथं जाता देवेन्द्रस्य महात्मनः ..
कस्मिन्काले च सर्वं नो विस्तरात्सूत कीर्तय .. 32 ..
5.8.m: The seers said: / How did the sin of killing a brahmin befall the great-souled Indra? / And at what time? O Sūta, relate it all to us in detail!

5.8.s:
raktaśṛṃgo giriḥ ko'yaṃ saṃkṣiptastatra tena yaḥ ..
mānuṣāṇāṃ bhayaṃ tasya katamasya śacīpateḥ .. 33 ..
5.8.d:
रक्तशृंगो गिरिः कोऽयं संक्षिप्तस्तत्र तेन यः ..
मानुषाणां भयं तस्य कतमस्य शचीपतेः .. 33 ..
5.8.m: What is this Raktaśṛṅga mountain that was thrown down there by him? / And which Indra (Śacīpati) felt fear toward mortals?

5.8.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
purā tvaṣṭrā dvijaśreṣṭhā hiraṇyakaśipoḥ sutā ..
vivāhitā ramānāma śreṣṭharūpaguṇānvitā .. 34 ..
5.8.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
पुरा त्वष्ट्रा द्विजश्रेष्ठा हिरण्यकशिपोः सुता ..
विवाहिता रमानाम श्रेष्ठरूपगुणान्विता .. 34 ..
5.8.m: Sūta said: / Formerly, O best of brahmins, the daughter of Hiraṇyakaśipu, / named Ramā, endowed with supreme beauty and virtues, was married by Tvaṣṭṛ.

5.8.s:
atha tasyā yayau kālaḥ suprabhūtaḥ sutaṃ vinā ..
tato vairāgyasaṃpannā sutārthaṃ tapasi sthitā ... .. 35 ..
5.8.d:
अथ तस्या ययौ कालः सुप्रभूतः सुतं विना ..
ततो वैराग्यसंपन्ना सुतार्थं तपसि स्थिता ... .. 35 ..
5.8.m: Then a very long time passed for her without a son. / Then, filled with dispassion, she engaged in austerity to obtain a son,

5.8.s:
dhyāyamānā surādhīśaṃ devadevaṃ maheśvaram ..
balipūjopahāreṇa samyakchraddhāsamanvitā .. 36 ..
5.8.d:
ध्यायमाना सुराधीशं देवदेवं महेश्वरम् ..
बलिपूजोपहारेण सम्यक्छ्रद्धासमन्विता .. 36 ..
5.8.m: meditating upon Maheśvara, the lord of gods, the god of gods, / with offerings of worship and tributes, endowed with complete faith,

5.8.s:
niyatā niyatāhārā snānajapyaparāyaṇā ..
yacchamānā dvijāgryebhyo dānāni vividhāni ca .. 37 ..
5.8.d:
नियता नियताहारा स्नानजप्यपरायणा ..
यच्छमाना द्विजाग्र्येभ्यो दानानि विविधानि च .. 37 ..
5.8.m: restrained, limited in diet, devoted to ritual ablution and japa, / and bestowing gifts of various kinds upon the best of brahmins.

5.8.s:
tato varṣasahasrāṃte tasyāstuṣṭo maheśvaraḥ ..
uvāca varado'smīti vṛṇuṣva yadabhīpsitam .. 38 ..
5.8.d:
ततो वर्षसहस्रांते तस्यास्तुष्टो महेश्वरः ..
उवाच वरदोऽस्मीति वृणुष्व यदभीप्सितम् .. 38 ..
5.8.m: Then, at the end of a thousand years, Maheśvara was pleased with her / and said, "I am the granter of boons; choose what you desire."

5.8.s:
sā vavre mama putro'stu bhagavaṃstvatprasādataḥ ..
śūraḥ śastrairavadhyaśca vipradānavarūpadhṛk .. 39 ..
5.8.d:
सा वव्रे मम पुत्रोऽस्तु भगवंस्त्वत्प्रसादतः ..
शूरः शस्त्रैरवध्यश्च विप्रदानवरूपधृक् .. 39 ..
5.8.m: She chose: "O Blessed One, by your grace let me have a son / who is heroic, invulnerable to weapons, and bears the form of a brahmin and a dānava,

5.8.s:
vedādhyayana saṃpanno yajñakarmasamudyataḥ ..
tejasā yaśasā khyātaḥ sarveṣāmapi dehinām .. 6.8.40 ..
5.8.d:
वेदाध्ययन संपन्नो यज्ञकर्मसमुद्यतः ..
तेजसा यशसा ख्यातः सर्वेषामपि देहिनाम् .. 6.8.40 ..
5.8.m: accomplished in Vedic study, dedicated to sacrificial rites, / renowned for splendor and fame among all embodied beings."

5.8.s:
.. bhagavānuvāca .. ..
bhaviṣyati na saṃdehaḥ putraste balavānsudhīḥ ..
avadhyaḥ sarvaśastrāṇāṃ mahātejobhiranvitaḥ .. 41 ..
5.8.d:
.. भगवानुवाच .. ..
भविष्यति न संदेहः पुत्रस्ते बलवान्सुधीः ..
अवध्यः सर्वशस्त्राणां महातेजोभिरन्वितः .. 41 ..
5.8.m: The Blessed One said: / Without doubt your son will be mighty and wise, / invulnerable to all weapons, endowed with great splendor,

5.8.s:
yajvā dānapatiḥ śūro vedavedāṃgapāragaḥ ..
brāhmaṇoktāḥ kriyāḥ sarvāḥ kariṣyati sa kṛtsnaśaḥ ..
ajeyaḥ saṃgare caiva kṛtsnairapi surāsuraiḥ .. 42 ..
5.8.d:
यज्वा दानपतिः शूरो वेदवेदांगपारगः ..
ब्राह्मणोक्ताः क्रियाः सर्वाः करिष्यति स कृत्स्नशः ..
अजेयः संगरे चैव कृत्स्नैरपि सुरासुरैः .. 42 ..
5.8.m: a sacrificer, a master of generosity, a hero, a master of the Vedas and Vedāṅgas; / he will perform in full all rites ordained for brahmins, / and he will be invincible in battle even by all the gods and asuras.

5.8.s:
evamuktvā sa deveśastataścādarśanaṃ gataḥ ..
ṛtau sāpi dadhe garbhaṃ sakāśādviśvakarmaṇaḥ .. .. 43 ..
5.8.d:
एवमुक्त्वा स देवेशस्ततश्चादर्शनं गतः ..
ऋतौ सापि दधे गर्भं सकाशाद्विश्वकर्मणः .. .. 43 ..
5.8.m: Having spoken thus, the lord of gods vanished from there. / And in due season, she conceived an embryo from Viśvakarman.

5.8.s:
tataśca suṣuve putraṃ daśame māsi śobhanam ..
dvādaśārkapratīkāśaṃ sarvalakṣaṇalakṣitam .. 44 ..
5.8.d:
ततश्च सुषुवे पुत्रं दशमे मासि शोभनम् ..
द्वादशार्कप्रतीकाशं सर्वलक्षणलक्षितम् .. 44 ..
5.8.m: Then, in the tenth month, she gave birth to a radiant son, / resembling twelve suns and endowed with all auspicious marks.

5.8.s:
tasya cakre pitā nāma prāpte dvādaśame dine ...
prasiddhaṃ vṛtra ityeva pūjayitvā dvijottamān .. 45 ..
5.8.d:
तस्य चक्रे पिता नाम प्राप्ते द्वादशमे दिने ...
प्रसिद्धं वृत्र इत्येव पूजयित्वा द्विजोत्तमान् .. 45 ..
5.8.m: When the twelfth day arrived, after worshipping the best of brahmins, / his father gave him the famous name Vṛtra.

5.8.s:
athāsau vavṛdhe bālaḥ śuklapakṣe yathoḍurāṭ ..
pitṛmātṛkṛtānaṃdo bandhuvargeṇa lālitaḥ .. 46..
5.8.d:
अथासौ ववृधे बालः शुक्लपक्षे यथोडुराट् ..
पितृमातृकृतानंदो बन्धुवर्गेण लालितः .. 46..
5.8.m: Then that boy grew like the moon in the bright fortnight, / bringing joy to his father and mother, pampered by the circle of his kinsmen.

5.8.s:
tato'sya pradadau kāle vrataṃ viprajanocitam ..
samabhyetya svayaṃ śukro dānavasyāpi saṃdvijaḥ .. 47 ..
5.8.d:
ततोऽस्य प्रददौ काले व्रतं विप्रजनोचितम् ..
समभ्येत्य स्वयं शुक्रो दानवस्यापि संद्विजः .. 47 ..
5.8.m: Then, in due time, Śukra himself, coming as a brahmin / to the dānava, imparted to him the vow proper for brahmins.

5.8.s:
sa cāpi caturo vedānbrahmacārivrate sthitaḥ ..
vedāṃgaiḥ sahitānvṛtraḥ papāṭha guruvatsalaḥ .. 48 ..
5.8.d:
स चापि चतुरो वेदान्ब्रह्मचारिव्रते स्थितः ..
वेदांगैः सहितान्वृत्रः पपाठ गुरुवत्सलः .. 48 ..
5.8.m: And observing the vow of a brahmacārin, Vṛtra, devoted to his preceptor, / studied the four Vedas together with the Vedāṅgas.

5.8.s:
tato yauvanamāsādya bhūmipālānaśeṣataḥ ..
jitvā dharāṃ vaśe cakre pātālaṃ tadanaṃta ram.. 49 ..
5.8.d:
ततो यौवनमासाद्य भूमिपालानशेषतः ..
जित्वा धरां वशे चक्रे पातालं तदनंत रम्.. 49 ..
5.8.m: Then, having attained youth, he conquered all the kings, / brought the earth under his control, and after that, Pātāla.

5.8.s:
tataśceṃdrajayākāṃkṣī samāsāya surālayam ..
sahasrākṣamukhāndevānyuddhe cakre parāṅmukhān .. 6.8.50 ..
5.8.d:
ततश्चेंद्रजयाकांक्षी समासाय सुरालयम् ..
सहस्राक्षमुखान्देवान्युद्धे चक्रे पराङ्मुखान् .. 6.8.50 ..
5.8.m: Then, desiring to conquer Indra, he reached the abode of the gods / and put to flight in battle the gods headed by the thousand-eyed Indra.

5.8.s:
atha tena samaṃ vajrī cakre'ṣṭādaśa saṃyugān..
ekasminnapi no lebhe vijayaṃ dvijasattamāḥ .. 51 ..
5.8.d:
अथ तेन समं वज्री चक्रेऽष्टादश संयुगान्..
एकस्मिन्नपि नो लेभे विजयं द्विजसत्तमाः .. 51 ..
5.8.m: Then the wielder of the vajra fought eighteen battles with him, / yet he did not obtain victory even in one, O best of brahmins.

5.8.s:
hataśeṣaiḥ suraiḥ sārdhaṃ sarvāṃgakṣatavikṣataiḥ ..
tato jagāma vitrasto brahmalokaṃ divā layāt.. 52 ..
5.8.d:
हतशेषैः सुरैः सार्धं सर्वांगक्षतविक्षतैः ..
ततो जगाम वित्रस्तो ब्रह्मलोकं दिवा लयात्.. 52 ..
5.8.m: Along with the surviving gods whose bodies were all slashed and wounded, / he then fled terrified from the realm of heaven to Brahmā's world.

5.8.s:
vṛtro'pi bubhuje kṛtsnaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaram ..
śākraṃ padaṃ samāsthāya nihatāśeṣakaṃṭakam .. 53 ..
5.8.d:
वृत्रोऽपि बुभुजे कृत्स्नं त्रैलोक्यं सचराचरम् ..
शाक्रं पदं समास्थाय निहताशेषकंटकम् .. 53 ..
5.8.m: Vṛtra, too, enjoyed the entire three worlds with all that moves and does not move; / having established himself in Indra's position, his every obstacle was eliminated.

5.8.s:
yajñabhāgabhujaścakre dānavānbala garvitān ..
devasthāneṣu sarveṣu yathokteṣu mahābalaḥ .. 54 ..
5.8.d:
यज्ञभागभुजश्चक्रे दानवान्बल गर्वितान् ..
देवस्थानेषु सर्वेषु यथोक्तेषु महाबलः .. 54 ..
5.8.m: The mighty one made the dānavas, proud of their strength, / the enjoyers of sacrificial shares in all the prescribed places of the gods.

5.8.s:
evaṃ trailokyarājye'pi labdhe tasya dvijottamāḥ ..
na saṃtoṣaśca saṃjajñe brahmalokābhi kāṃkṣayā .. 55 ..
5.8.d:
एवं त्रैलोक्यराज्येऽपि लब्धे तस्य द्विजोत्तमाः ..
न संतोषश्च संजज्ञे ब्रह्मलोकाभि कांक्षया .. 55 ..
5.8.m: Even when sovereignty over the three worlds was thus attained, O best of brahmins, / he felt no contentment, because of his longing for the world of Brahmā.

5.8.s:
tataḥ śukraṃ samāhūya provāca madhuraṃ vacaḥ ..
vinayāvanato bhūtvā caturbhiḥ sacivaiḥ saha .. 56 ..
5.8.d:
ततः शुक्रं समाहूय प्रोवाच मधुरं वचः ..
विनयावनतो भूत्वा चतुर्भिः सचिवैः सह .. 56 ..
5.8.m: Then, having summoned Śukra, he bowed with humility / and spoke sweet words along with his four ministers.

5.8.s:
.. vṛtra uvāca .. ..
brahmalokaṃ gataḥ śakro bhayādgurukulodvaha ..
kathaṃ gatirbhavettatra mama brūhi yathātatham .. 57 ..
5.8.d:
.. वृत्र उवाच .. ..
ब्रह्मलोकं गतः शक्रो भयाद्गुरुकुलोद्वह ..
कथं गतिर्भवेत्तत्र मम ब्रूहि यथातथम् .. 57 ..
5.8.m: Vṛtra said: / Out of fear, Indra has gone to the world of Brahmā, O upholder of the lineage of preceptors; / tell me truthfully how there may be access for me thither,

5.8.s:
yena śakraṃ viraṃciṃ ca sūdayiṣye tathākhilam ..
tubhyaṃ dattvā brahma lokaṃ bhokṣyāmi tridivaṃ svayam .. 58 ..
5.8.d:
येन शक्रं विरंचिं च सूदयिष्ये तथाखिलम् ..
तुभ्यं दत्त्वा ब्रह्म लोकं भोक्ष्यामि त्रिदिवं स्वयम् .. 58 ..
5.8.m: so that I may destroy Indra, Brahmā (Virañci), and all the rest; / and having given the world of Brahmā to you, I shall myself enjoy heaven.

5.8.s:
.. śukra uvāca .. ..
na gatirvidyate tatra tava dānavasattama ..
tasmāttrailokyarājyena saṃtoṣaṃ kartuma rhasi .. 59 ..
5.8.d:
.. शुक्र उवाच .. ..
न गतिर्विद्यते तत्र तव दानवसत्तम ..
तस्मात्त्रैलोक्यराज्येन संतोषं कर्तुम र्हसि .. 59 ..
5.8.m: Śukra said: / There is no access there for you, O best of dānavas; / therefore, you should be content with the sovereignty over the three worlds.

5.8.s:
.. vṛtra uvāca .. ..
yāvattiṣṭhati sutrāmā tāvannāsti sukhaṃ mama ..
tasmānniṣkaṃṭakārthāya yatiṣye'haṃ dvijottama .. 6.8.60 ..
5.8.d:
.. वृत्र उवाच .. ..
यावत्तिष्ठति सुत्रामा तावन्नास्ति सुखं मम ..
तस्मान्निष्कंटकार्थाय यतिष्येऽहं द्विजोत्तम .. 6.8.60 ..
5.8.m: Vṛtra said: / As long as Indra remains, there is no happiness for me. / Therefore, O best of brahmins, I will strive to make my path free of thorns.

5.8.s:
kathaṃ śakrasya saṃjātā gatistatra bhṛgūdvaha ..
na bhaviṣyati me brūhi kathaṃ sā'dya mahāmate .. 61 ..
5.8.d:
कथं शक्रस्य संजाता गतिस्तत्र भृगूद्वह ..
न भविष्यति मे ब्रूहि कथं साऽद्य महामते .. 61 ..
5.8.m: How did Indra obtain access there, O descendant of Bhṛgu? / Tell me, O noble-minded one, why that [access] will not be mine today?

5.8.s:
.. śukra uvāca .. ..
tena pūrvaṃ tapastaptaṃ naimiṣe dānavottama ..
yāvadvarṣasahasrāṃtaṃ dhyāyamānena śaṃkaram.. 62 ..
5.8.d:
.. शुक्र उवाच .. ..
तेन पूर्वं तपस्तप्तं नैमिषे दानवोत्तम ..
यावद्वर्षसहस्रांतं ध्यायमानेन शंकरम्.. 62 ..
5.8.m:
Śukra said:
"Formerly, tapas was performed by him in Naimiṣa, O best of Dānavas, / meditating on Śaṃkara until the end of a thousand years. 62

5.8.s:
tatprabhāvādgatistasya tatra jātā sadaiva hi ..
sabhṛtyaparivārasya nānyadastīha kāraṇam.. 63 ..
5.8.d:
तत्प्रभावाद्गतिस्तस्य तत्र जाता सदैव हि ..
सभृत्यपरिवारस्य नान्यदस्तीह कारणम्.. 63 ..
5.8.m: Indeed, by that power his attainment there came about always, / along with his servants and retinue; there is no other cause here. 63

5.8.s:
yo'nyo'pi naimiṣāraṇye tadrūpaṃ kurute tapaḥ ..
brahmaloke gatistasya jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 64 ..
5.8.d:
योऽन्योऽपि नैमिषारण्ये तद्रूपं कुरुते तपः ..
ब्रह्मलोके गतिस्तस्य जायते नात्र संशयः .. 64 ..
5.8.m: Whoever else also performs such tapas in Naimiṣāraṇya, / his attainment occurs in the world of Brahmā; there is no doubt of this." 64

5.8.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
tacchrutvā satvaraṃ gatvā naimiṣaṃ tīrthamuttamam ..
tapaścakre tatastīvraṃ dhyāyamāno maheśvaram .. 65 ..
5.8.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
तच्छ्रुत्वा सत्वरं गत्वा नैमिषं तीर्थमुत्तमम् ..
तपश्चक्रे ततस्तीव्रं ध्यायमानो महेश्वरम् .. 65 ..
5.8.m:
Sūta said:
Having heard that, he went swiftly to Naimiṣa, the excellent sacred ford; / he then performed severe tapas, meditating on Maheśvara, 65

5.8.s:
trailokyarakṣaṇārthāya saṃnirūpya danūtta mān..
mahābalasamopetāñchakrādhikaparākramān .. 66 ..
5.8.d:
त्रैलोक्यरक्षणार्थाय संनिरूप्य दनूत्त मान्..
महाबलसमोपेताञ्छक्राधिकपराक्रमान् .. 66 ..
5.8.m: having appointed the best of Danus for the protection of the three worlds, / who were endowed with great strength, surpassing Śakra in prowess. 66

5.8.s:
varṣāsvākāśasthāyī sa hemante salilāśrayaḥ ..
paṃcāgnisādhako grīṣme sa vabhūvā nilāśanaḥ .. 67 ..
5.8.d:
वर्षास्वाकाशस्थायी स हेमन्ते सलिलाश्रयः ..
पंचाग्निसाधको ग्रीष्मे स वभूवा निलाशनः .. 67 ..
5.8.m: Standing under the open sky in the rains, taking refuge in water in the winter, / practicing the five fires in summer, he became one who feeds on air. 67

5.8.s:
evaṃ tasya vratasthasya jagmurvarṣaśatāni ca ..
tatra bhītāstato devā brahmaviṣṇupuraḥsarāḥ .. 68 ..
5.8.d:
एवं तस्य व्रतस्थस्य जग्मुर्वर्षशतानि च ..
तत्र भीतास्ततो देवा ब्रह्मविष्णुपुरःसराः .. 68 ..
5.8.m: Thus, as he remained firm in his vow, hundreds of years passed. / Thereupon the gods, led by Brahmā and Viṣṇu, were terrified. 68

5.8.s:
cakruśca satataṃ maṃtraṃ tadvināśāya kevalam ..
vīkṣayaṃti ca cchidrāṇi na ca paśyaṃti duḥkhitāḥ .. 69 ..
5.8.d:
चक्रुश्च सततं मंत्रं तद्विनाशाय केवलम् ..
वीक्षयंति च च्छिद्राणि न च पश्यंति दुःखिताः .. 69 ..
5.8.m: And they held counsel constantly, solely for his destruction; / and distressed, they searched for weaknesses, but saw none. 69

5.8.s:
athābravītsvayaṃ viṣṇuściraṃ niścitya cetasā ..
vadhopāyaṃ samālokya vṛtrasya pramudānvitaḥ . 6.8.70 ..
5.8.d:
अथाब्रवीत्स्वयं विष्णुश्चिरं निश्चित्य चेतसा ..
वधोपायं समालोक्य वृत्रस्य प्रमुदान्वितः . 6.8.70 ..
5.8.m: Then Viṣṇu himself spoke, having reflected in his mind for a long time, / having discerned the means of slaying Vṛtra, filled with joy: 70

5.8.s:
.. viṣṇuruvāca .. ..
tasya śakra vadhopāyo mayā jñāto'dhunā dhruvam ..
tacchrutvā kuru śīghraṃ tvamupāyo nāsti kaścana .. 71 ..
5.8.d:
.. विष्णुरुवाच .. ..
तस्य शक्र वधोपायो मया ज्ञातोऽधुना ध्रुवम् ..
तच्छ्रुत्वा कुरु शीघ्रं त्वमुपायो नास्ति कश्चन .. 71 ..
5.8.m:
Viṣṇu said:
"The means of slaying him has now indeed been known by me, O Śakra; / having heard it, act quickly; there is no other means. 71

5.8.s:
avadhyaḥ sarvaśastrāṇāṃ sa kṛtaḥ śūlapāṇinā ..
tasmādasthimayaṃ vajraṃ tadvadhārthaṃ nirūpaya .. 72 ..
5.8.d:
अवध्यः सर्वशस्त्राणां स कृतः शूलपाणिना ..
तस्मादस्थिमयं वज्रं तद्वधार्थं निरूपय .. 72 ..
5.8.m: He has been made invulnerable to all weapons by the holder of the trident; / therefore, prepare a thunderbolt made of bone for his slaying." 72

5.8.s:
.. indra uvāca .. ..
asthibhiḥ kasya jīvasya vajraṃ deva bhaviṣyati ..
gajasya śarabhasyātha kiṃ vānyasya vadasva me .. 73 ..
5.8.d:
.. इन्द्र उवाच .. ..
अस्थिभिः कस्य जीवस्य वज्रं देव भविष्यति ..
गजस्य शरभस्याथ किं वान्यस्य वदस्व मे .. 73 ..
5.8.m:
Indra said:
"From the bones of which living being will the thunderbolt be made, O Lord? / Of an elephant, or of a śarabha, or of another? Tell me!" 73

5.8.s:
.. viṣṇuruvāca .. ..
śatahastapramāṇaṃ tatṣaḍasri ca surādhipa ..
madhye kṣāmaṃ tu pārśvābhyāṃ sthūlaṃ raudrasamākṛti .. 74 ..
5.8.d:
.. विष्णुरुवाच .. ..
शतहस्तप्रमाणं तत्षडस्रि च सुराधिप ..
मध्ये क्षामं तु पार्श्वाभ्यां स्थूलं रौद्रसमाकृति .. 74 ..
5.8.m:
Viṣṇu said:
"It must be a hundred cubits in length, six-cornered, O lord of the gods, / slender in the middle, but thick on both sides, with a fearsome form." 74

5.8.s:
.. iṃdra uvāca .. ..
na tādṛgdṛśyate sattvaṃ trailokyepi sureśvara ..
yasyāsthibhirvidhīyeta vajamevaṃvidhākṛti .. 75 ..
5.8.d:
.. इंद्र उवाच .. ..
न तादृग्दृश्यते सत्त्वं त्रैलोक्येपि सुरेश्वर ..
यस्यास्थिभिर्विधीयेत वजमेवंविधाकृति .. 75 ..
5.8.m:
Indra said:
"No such living creature is seen even in the three worlds, O lord of the gods, / with whose bones a thunderbolt of such a form could be made." 75

5.8.s:
.. viṣṇuruvāca .. ..
dadhīcirnāma vipro'sti tapaḥ paramamā sthitaḥ ..
dviguṇaṃ ca tathā dīrghaḥ sarasvatyāṃ kṛtāśramaḥ .. 76 ..
5.8.d:
.. विष्णुरुवाच .. ..
दधीचिर्नाम विप्रोऽस्ति तपः परममा स्थितः ..
द्विगुणं च तथा दीर्घः सरस्वत्यां कृताश्रमः .. 76 ..
5.8.m:
Viṣṇu said:
"There is a brahmin named Dadhīci, established in supreme tapas, / and twice as tall, who has made his hermitage at the Sarasvatī. 76

5.8.s:
taṃ gatvā prārthayāśu tvaṃ svānyasthīni pradāsyati ..
nādeyaṃ vidyate kiṃcittasya saṃprārthitasya hi .. 77 .
5.8.d:
तं गत्वा प्रार्थयाशु त्वं स्वान्यस्थीनि प्रदास्यति ..
नादेयं विद्यते किंचित्तस्य संप्रार्थितस्य हि .. 77 .
5.8.m: Go to him and quickly beg; he will give his own bones. / For there is nothing that cannot be given by him when he is entreated." 77

5.8.s:
tataḥ śakraḥ suraiḥ sārdhaṃ gatvā tasya tadāśramam ..
prācīsarasvatītīre puṣkare dvijasattamāḥ .. 79 .
atha devānsamā lokya saṃprāptānnijamaṃdire ..
dadhīciḥ saṃprahṛṣṭātmā satvaraḥ saṃmukhaṃ yayau .. 79 ..
5.8.d:
ततः शक्रः सुरैः सार्धं गत्वा तस्य तदाश्रमम् ..
प्राचीसरस्वतीतीरे पुष्करे द्विजसत्तमाः .. 79 .
अथ देवान्समा लोक्य संप्राप्तान्निजमंदिरे ..
दधीचिः संप्रहृष्टात्मा सत्वरः संमुखं ययौ .. 79 ..
5.8.m:
Then Śakra, along with the gods, having gone to his hermitage / on the bank of the eastern Sarasvatī at Puṣkara, O best of brahmins— 79
Then, seeing the gods arrived at his own dwelling, / Dadhīci, delighted in mind, swiftly went forward [to meet them]. 79

5.8.s:
sa praṇamya sahasrākṣaṃ tathānyānapi sanmuniḥ ..
arghyādibhistataḥ pūjāṃ cakre teṣāṃ tataḥ param .. 6.8.80 ..
5.8.d:
स प्रणम्य सहस्राक्षं तथान्यानपि सन्मुनिः ..
अर्घ्यादिभिस्ततः पूजां चक्रे तेषां ततः परम् .. 6.8.80 ..
5.8.m: Having bowed to the thousand-eyed one as well as to the other [gods], that good sage / then performed worship of them with guest-water and the rest, and after that, 80

5.8.s:
tataḥ provāca hṛṣṭātmā vinayāvanataḥ sthitaḥ ..
svayameva sahasrākṣaṃ praṇipatya muhurmuhuḥ .. 81 .. ..
5.8.d:
ततः प्रोवाच हृष्टात्मा विनयावनतः स्थितः ..
स्वयमेव सहस्राक्षं प्रणिपत्य मुहुर्मुहुः .. 81 .. ..
5.8.m: standing bent low in humility, his soul gladdened, / himself bowing again and again to the thousand-eyed one, he said: 81

5.8.s:
.. dadhīciruvāca .. ..
kimarthamāgatā devāḥ kṛtyaṃ cāśu nivedyatām ..
dhanyo'hamāgato yasya gṛhe tvaṃ balasūdana .. 82 ..
5.8.d:
.. दधीचिरुवाच .. ..
किमर्थमागता देवाः कृत्यं चाशु निवेद्यताम् ..
धन्योऽहमागतो यस्य गृहे त्वं बलसूदन .. 82 ..
5.8.m:
Dadhīci said:
"For what purpose have the gods come? Let the task be declared quickly. / Blessed am I in whose home you have arrived, O slayer of Bala!" 82

5.8.s:
.. śakra uvāca .. ..
vṛtreṇa nirjitāḥ sarve vayaṃ brāhmaṇasattama ..
sa vadhyo nahi śastrāṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ varapuṣṭitaḥ . 83 ..
5.8.d:
.. शक्र उवाच .. ..
वृत्रेण निर्जिताः सर्वे वयं ब्राह्मणसत्तम ..
स वध्यो नहि शस्त्राणां सर्वेषां वरपुष्टितः . 83 ..
5.8.m:
Śakra said:
"We have all been conquered by Vṛtra, O best of brahmins. / Strengthened by a boon, he cannot be slain by any weapons. 83

5.8.s:
so'sthisaṃbhavavajrasya vadhyaḥ syādabravīddhariḥ..
śatahastapramāṇasya na ca jīvosti tādṛśaḥ .. 84 ..
5.8.d:
सोऽस्थिसंभववज्रस्य वध्यः स्यादब्रवीद्धरिः..
शतहस्तप्रमाणस्य न च जीवोस्ति तादृशः .. 84 ..
5.8.m: Hari said that he may be killed by a thunderbolt produced from bone, / and there is no living being of the measure of a hundred cubits 84

5.8.s:
tvāṃ muktvā brāhmaṇaśreṣṭha tasmādasthīni yaccha naḥ ..
svakīyāni bhavedyena vajraṃ tasya vināśakam .. 85 ..
5.8.d:
त्वां मुक्त्वा ब्राह्मणश्रेष्ठ तस्मादस्थीनि यच्छ नः ..
स्वकीयानि भवेद्येन वज्रं तस्य विनाशकम् .. 85 ..
5.8.m: except you, O best of brahmins; therefore, give us your own / bones, by which a thunderbolt destructive to him may come to be. 85

5.8.s:
kuru kṛtyaṃ dvijaśreṣṭha devānāmārtināśanam ..
anyathā vibudhāḥ sarve nāśaṃ yāsyaṃti kṛtsnaśaḥ .. 86 ..
5.8.d:
कुरु कृत्यं द्विजश्रेष्ठ देवानामार्तिनाशनम् ..
अन्यथा विबुधाः सर्वे नाशं यास्यंति कृत्स्नशः .. 86 ..
5.8.m: Perform this duty, O best of brahmins, destroying the distress of the gods; / otherwise, all the gods will completely perish." 86

5.8.s:
.. sūta uvāca ..
tacchrutvā saṃprahṛṣṭātmā dadhīcirbhagavānmuniḥ ..
atyajajjīvitaṃ teṣāṃ hitārthāya divaukasām .. 87 ..
5.8.d:
.. सूत उवाच ..
तच्छ्रुत्वा संप्रहृष्टात्मा दधीचिर्भगवान्मुनिः ..
अत्यजज्जीवितं तेषां हितार्थाय दिवौकसाम् .. 87 ..
5.8.m:
Sūta said:
Having heard that, the venerable sage Dadhīci, gladdened in mind, / abandoned his life for the sake of the welfare of those dwellers in heaven. 87

5.8.s:
tato devāḥ prahṛṣṭāste gṛhītvāsthīni kṛtsnaśaḥ ..
tataścakrurmahāvajraṃ yādṛśaṃ viṣṇunoditam .. 88 ..
5.8.d:
ततो देवाः प्रहृष्टास्ते गृहीत्वास्थीनि कृत्स्नशः ..
ततश्चक्रुर्महावज्रं यादृशं विष्णुनोदितम् .. 88 ..
5.8.m: Then those gods, delighted, took all the bones; / then they fashioned a great thunderbolt such as had been described by Viṣṇu. 88

5.8.s:
atha śakrastadādāya naimiṣābhimukho yayau ..
bhayena mahatā yukto vepamāno niśāgame .. 89 ..
5.8.d:
अथ शक्रस्तदादाय नैमिषाभिमुखो ययौ ..
भयेन महता युक्तो वेपमानो निशागमे .. 89 ..
5.8.m: Then Śakra, taking that, went facing toward Naimiṣa, / filled with great fear, trembling at the arrival of night. 89

5.8.s:
tatra dhyānasthitaṃ vṛtraṃ dūrasthastridaśādhipaḥ ..
vajreṇa tāḍayāmāsa palāyanaparāyaṇaḥ .. 6.8.90 ..
5.8.d:
तत्र ध्यानस्थितं वृत्रं दूरस्थस्त्रिदशाधिपः ..
