वज्रेण ताडयामास पलायनपरायणः .. 6.8.90 ..
5.8.m: There, standing far off, the lord of the thirty [gods] struck with the thunderbolt / Vṛtra as he was situated in meditation, intent on fleeing. 90

5.8.s:
so'pi vajaprahāreṇa bhasmasātsama padyata ..
vṛtro dānavaśārdūlo vahniṃ prāpya pataṃgavat .. 91 ..
5.8.d:
सोऽपि वजप्रहारेण भस्मसात्सम पद्यत ..
वृत्रो दानवशार्दूलो वह्निं प्राप्य पतंगवत् .. 91 ..
5.8.m: He too, by the strike of the thunderbolt, was reduced to ashes— / Vṛtra, the tiger among Dānavas, like a moth reaching fire. 91

5.8.s:
śakro'pi bhayasaṃtrasto gatvā sāgaramadhyagam ..
parvataṃ sudurārohaṃ tuṃgaśṛṃgaṃ samāśritaḥ .. .. 92 ..
5.8.d:
शक्रोऽपि भयसंत्रस्तो गत्वा सागरमध्यगम् ..
पर्वतं सुदुरारोहं तुंगशृंगं समाश्रितः .. .. 92 ..
5.8.m: Śakra too, thoroughly terrified with fear, went to a mountain / situated in the midst of the ocean, very difficult to climb, and took refuge on its high peak. 92

5.8.s:
na jānāti hataṃ vṛtraṃ vajraghātena tena tam ..
kevalaṃ vīkṣate mārgaṃ vṛtrāgamanasaṃbhavam .. 93 ..
5.8.d:
न जानाति हतं वृत्रं वज्रघातेन तेन तम् ..
केवलं वीक्षते मार्गं वृत्रागमनसंभवम् .. 93 ..
5.8.m: He did not know that Vṛtra had been slain by that stroke of the thunderbolt; / he only watched the path where Vṛtra's arrival might occur. 93

5.8.s:
etasminnaṃtare devāḥ saṃprahṛṣṭatanūruhāḥ .
sūtraṃ vinihataṃ dṛṣṭvā tuṣṭuvustridaśādhipam .. 94 ..
5.8.d:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे देवाः संप्रहृष्टतनूरुहाः .
सूत्रं विनिहतं दृष्ट्वा तुष्टुवुस्त्रिदशाधिपम् .. 94 ..
5.8.m: Meanwhile, the gods, the hair of their bodies bristling with delight, / having seen Vṛtra slain, praised the lord of the thirty [gods]. 94

5.8.s:
na jānaṃti bhayānnaṣṭaṃ tasminsāgaraparvate .
anviṣya cirakālena kṛcchrātsaṃprāpya taṃ tataḥ.. 95 ..
5.8.d:
न जानंति भयान्नष्टं तस्मिन्सागरपर्वते .
अन्विष्य चिरकालेन कृच्छ्रात्संप्राप्य तं ततः.. 95 ..
5.8.m: Not knowing that he had disappeared out of fear to that ocean mountain, / searching for a long time and reaching him with difficulty, they then 95

5.8.s:
vīkṣāṃcakruḥ samāsīnaṃ viṣame girigahvare ..
tejohīnaṃ tathā dīnaṃ brahmahatyāpariplutam .. 96 ..
5.8.d:
वीक्षांचक्रुः समासीनं विषमे गिरिगह्वरे ..
तेजोहीनं तथा दीनं ब्रह्महत्यापरिप्लुतम् .. 96 ..
5.8.m: saw him seated in a rugged mountain cave, / bereft of splendor, wretched, and engulfed by the murder of a brahmin, 96

5.8.s: gātradurgaṃdhitāsaṃgaiḥ pūrayantaṃ diśo daśa .. 97 ..
5.8.d: गात्रदुर्गंधितासंगैः पूरयन्तं दिशो दश .. 97 ..
5.8.m: filling the ten directions with the stench emanating from his limbs. 97

5.8.s:
athovāca caturvaktro dṛṣṭvā śakraṃ tathāvidham ..
samastāndevasaṃghātāndūrasthaḥ pāpaśaṃkayā .. 98 ..
5.8.d:
अथोवाच चतुर्वक्त्रो दृष्ट्वा शक्रं तथाविधम् ..
समस्तान्देवसंघातान्दूरस्थः पापशंकया .. 98 ..
5.8.m: Then the four-faced one, seeing Śakra in such a condition, / standing at a distance out of fear of sin, said to the entire assembly of gods: 98

5.8.s:
śakro'yaṃ vibudhaśreṣṭhā brahmahatyāpariplutaḥ .
tasmātattyājyaḥ sudūreṇa no cetpāpamavāpsyatha .. 99 ..
5.8.d:
शक्रोऽयं विबुधश्रेष्ठा ब्रह्महत्यापरिप्लुतः .
तस्मातत्त्याज्यः सुदूरेण नो चेत्पापमवाप्स्यथ .. 99 ..
5.8.m: "This Śakra, O best of gods, is engulfed by the murder of a brahmin; / therefore, he must be abandoned from afar, lest you incur sin. 99

5.8.s:
paśyadhvaṃ sarvaliṃgāni brahmahatyānvitāni ca ..
asya gātreṣu dṛśyaṃte tasmādgacchāmahe divi .. 6.8.100 ..
5.8.d:
पश्यध्वं सर्वलिंगानि ब्रह्महत्यान्वितानि च ..
अस्य गात्रेषु दृश्यंते तस्माद्गच्छामहे दिवि .. 6.8.100 ..
5.8.m: Look! All the marks associated with the murder of a brahmin / are seen upon his limbs; therefore, let us go to heaven." 100

5.8.s:
pitāmahamukhāndṛṣṭvā devānprāptānsurādhipaḥ ..
parāṅmukhānakasmācca saṃjātānvismayānvitaḥ .......
tataḥ provāca saṃbhrāṃtaḥ kimidaṃ gamyate surāḥ ..
dṛṣṭvāpi māmanābhāṣya kaccitkṣemaṃ gṛhe mama .. 102 ..
5.8.d:
पितामहमुखान्दृष्ट्वा देवान्प्राप्तान्सुराधिपः ..
पराङ्मुखानकस्माच्च संजातान्विस्मयान्वितः .......
ततः प्रोवाच संभ्रांतः किमिदं गम्यते सुराः ..
दृष्ट्वापि मामनाभाष्य कच्चित्क्षेमं गृहे मम .. 102 ..
5.8.m: Seeing the gods arrived with the grandfather at their head, / and filled with wonder at their having suddenly turned away, / the lord of the gods, bewildered, then said: "Why are you going away, O gods, / having seen me without even speaking? Is all well in my house? 102

5.8.s:
kaccitsa nihatastena mama vajreṇa dānavaḥ ..
kaccinna māṃ sa yuddhārthamanveṣa yati durmatiḥ .. 103 ..
5.8.d:
कच्चित्स निहतस्तेन मम वज्रेण दानवः ..
कच्चिन्न मां स युद्धार्थमन्वेष यति दुर्मतिः .. 103 ..
5.8.m: Was that Dānava slain by that thunderbolt of mine? / Is that evil-minded one not searching for me for the sake of battle?" 103

5.8.s:
.. brahmovāca .. ..
nihataḥ sa tvayā śakra tena vajreṇa dānavaḥ ..
gato mṛtyuvaśaṃ pāpo na bhayaṃ kartumarhasi .. 104 ..
5.8.d:
.. ब्रह्मोवाच .. ..
निहतः स त्वया शक्र तेन वज्रेण दानवः ..
गतो मृत्युवशं पापो न भयं कर्तुमर्हसि .. 104 ..

5.8.s:
paraṃ tasya vadhājjātā brahmahatyā sugarhitā ..
tava śakra na tenādya spṛśāmo'spṛśyatāṃ gatam .. 105 ..
5.8.d:
परं तस्य वधाज्जाता ब्रह्महत्या सुगर्हिता ..
तव शक्र न तेनाद्य स्पृशामोऽस्पृश्यतां गतम् .. 105 ..
5.8.m:
However, from his slaying, the highly reprehensible murder of a brahmin has arisen
for you, O Śakra; therefore today we do not touch [you, who have] become untouchable. 105

5.8.s:
.. indra uvāca .. ..
mayā vinihatāḥ pūrvaṃ bahavaḥ kila dānavāḥ ..
brahmahatyā na saṃjātā mama hatyādhunā katham .. 106 ..
5.8.d:
.. इन्द्र उवाच .. ..
मया विनिहताः पूर्वं बहवः किल दानवाः ..
ब्रह्महत्या न संजाता मम हत्याधुना कथम् .. 106 ..

5.8.s:
.. brahmovāca .. ..
te tvayā nihatā yuddhe kṣātradharmeṇa vāsava ..
viśuddhā dānavāḥ sarve tena jātaṃ na pātakam .. 107 ..
5.8.d:
.. ब्रह्मोवाच .. ..
ते त्वया निहता युद्धे क्षात्रधर्मेण वासव ..
विशुद्धा दानवाः सर्वे तेन जातं न पातकम् .. 107 ..

5.8.s:
eṣa yajñopavītāḍhyo viśeṣāttapasi sthitaḥ.
chalena nihataḥ śakra tena tvaṃ pāpasaṃyutaḥ .. 108 .. ..
5.8.d:
एष यज्ञोपवीताढ्यो विशेषात्तपसि स्थितः.
छलेन निहतः शक्र तेन त्वं पापसंयुतः .. 108 .. ..
5.8.m:
This one was endowed with a sacred thread, especially engaged in austerity;
he was slain by trickery, O Śakra; therefore you are joined with sin. 108

5.8.s:
.. indra uvāca .. ..
jānāmyahaṃ caturvaktra svaṃ kāyaṃ pāpasaṃyutam ..
cihnairbrahmavadhodbhūtaistasmācchuddhiṃ vadasva me .. 109 ..
5.8.d:
.. इन्द्र उवाच .. ..
जानाम्यहं चतुर्वक्त्र स्वं कायं पापसंयुतम् ..
चिह्नैर्ब्रह्मवधोद्भूतैस्तस्माच्छुद्धिं वदस्व मे .. 109 ..
5.8.m:
Indra said:
I know, O four-faced one, that my own body is joined with sin
by the signs arising from the slaying of a brahmin; therefore, declare purification to me, 109

5.8.s:
yayā yāti drutaṃ pāpaṃ brahmahatyāsamudbhavam ..
spṛśyo bhavāmi sarveṣāṃ devānāṃ prapitāmaha .. 6.8.110 .
.. brahmovāca .. ..
tīrthayātrāṃ suraśreṣṭha tadarthaṃ kartumarhasi .
tayā vinā na te pāpaṃ nāśamāyāti kṛtsnaśaḥ .. 111 ..
5.8.d:
यया याति द्रुतं पापं ब्रह्महत्यासमुद्भवम् ..
स्पृश्यो भवामि सर्वेषां देवानां प्रपितामह .. 6.8.110 .
.. ब्रह्मोवाच .. ..
तीर्थयात्रां सुरश्रेष्ठ तदर्थं कर्तुमर्हसि .
तया विना न ते पापं नाशमायाति कृत्स्नशः .. 111 ..
5.8.m:
By which the sin arising from the murder of a brahmin quickly departs,
[and] I may become touchable to all the gods, O great-grandfather.
Brahmā said:
For that purpose, O best of the gods, you ought to undertake a pilgrimage to sacred fords;
without it, your sin will not go to destruction entirely. 111

5.8.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
tatastadvacanācchakrastīrthayātrāparāyaṇaḥ ..
babhrāma sakalāṃ pṛthvīṃ snānaṃ kurvanpṛthakpṛthak .. 112 ..
5.8.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
ततस्तद्वचनाच्छक्रस्तीर्थयात्रापरायणः ..
बभ्राम सकलां पृथ्वीं स्नानं कुर्वन्पृथक्पृथक् .. 112 ..
5.8.m:
Sūta said:
Then, by his word, Śakra, devoted to pilgrimage to sacred fords,
wandered over the entire earth, performing ritual ablutions separately [at each], 112

5.8.s:
tīrtheṣu suprasiddheṣu nadīnadayuteṣu ca ..
vārāṇasyāṃ prayāge ca prabhāse kurujāṃgale .. 113 ..
tathānyeṣu sahasrākṣo vipāpmā na vyajāyata ..
tato vairāgyamāpannaścintayāmāsa cetasi ...14..
5.8.d:
तीर्थेषु सुप्रसिद्धेषु नदीनदयुतेषु च ..
वाराणस्यां प्रयागे च प्रभासे कुरुजांगले .. 113 ..
तथान्येषु सहस्राक्षो विपाप्मा न व्यजायत ..
ततो वैराग्यमापन्नश्चिन्तयामास चेतसि ...14..
5.8.m:
At well-known sacred fords endowed with rivers and streams,
at Vārāṇasī, at Prayāga, at Prabhāsa, and in Kurujāṅgala; 113
And likewise at others, the thousand-eyed one did not become free from sin.
Then, fallen into despondency, he reflected in his mind: 114

5.8.s:
ahaṃ snātaḥ samasteṣu tīrtheṣu dharaṇītale..
na ca pāpena nirmuktaḥ kiṃ karomi ca sāṃpratam .. 115 ..
5.8.d:
अहं स्नातः समस्तेषु तीर्थेषु धरणीतले..
न च पापेन निर्मुक्तः किं करोमि च सांप्रतम् .. 115 ..
5.8.m:
“I have bathed in all the sacred fords on the surface of the earth,
and yet I am not freed from the sin. What shall I do now? 115

5.8.s:
kiṃ patāmi gireḥ śṛṃgādviṣaṃ vā bhakṣayāmi kim ..
trailokyarājyavibhraṣṭo nāhaṃ jīvitumutsahe .. 116 ..
5.8.d:
किं पतामि गिरेः शृंगाद्विषं वा भक्षयामि किम् ..
त्रैलोक्यराज्यविभ्रष्टो नाहं जीवितुमुत्सहे .. 116 ..
5.8.m:
Shall I fall from the peak of a mountain, or shall I consume poison?
Deprived of the sovereignty over the three worlds, I have no heart to live.” 116

5.8.s:
evaṃ vairāgyamāpanno girimāruhya vāsavaḥ ..
yāvatkṣipati cātmānaṃ maraṇe kṛtaniścayaḥ . 117 ..
5.8.d:
एवं वैराग्यमापन्नो गिरिमारुह्य वासवः ..
यावत्क्षिपति चात्मानं मरणे कृतनिश्चयः . 117 ..
5.8.m:
Having thus fallen into despondency, Vāsava climbed a mountain,
and as he was resolved upon death and about to throw himself down, 117

5.8.s:
tāvaddevotthitā vāṇī gaganāddvijasattamāḥ ..
mā śakra sāhasaṃ kārṣīrvairāgyaṃ prāpya cetasi .. 118 ..
5.8.d:
तावद्देवोत्थिता वाणी गगनाद्द्विजसत्तमाः ..
मा शक्र साहसं कार्षीर्वैराग्यं प्राप्य चेतसि .. 118 ..
5.8.m:
Just then a divine voice arose from the sky, O best of brahmins:
“O Śakra, do not commit a rash deed, having attained despondency in your heart! 118

5.8.s:
tvayā rājyaṃ prakartavyaṃ svarge'dyāpi yugāṣṭakam ..
tasmātpāpaviśuddhyarthaṃ śṛṇu śakra samā hitaḥ .. 119 ..
5.8.d:
त्वया राज्यं प्रकर्तव्यं स्वर्गेऽद्यापि युगाष्टकम् ..
तस्मात्पापविशुद्ध्यर्थं शृणु शक्र समा हितः .. 119 ..
5.8.m:
You have yet to rule in heaven for eight yugas.
Therefore, listen attentively for the purification of your sin, O Śakra! 119

5.8.s:
kuruṣva vacanaṃ śīghraṃ bhāvanīyaṃ na cānyathā ..
yattvayā pāṃsubhiḥ pūrvaṃ vivaraṃ paripūritaḥ .. 6.8.120 ..
5.8.d:
कुरुष्व वचनं शीघ्रं भावनीयं न चान्यथा ..
यत्त्वया पांसुभिः पूर्वं विवरं परिपूरितः .. 6.8.120 ..
5.8.m:
Swiftly carry out the instruction; it should not be conceived otherwise:
The opening which was formerly filled up with dust by you 120

5.8.s:
hāṭakeśvaraje kṣetre yatra devaḥ svayaṃ haraḥ ..
tatra nāgabilo jāto valmīkāttridaśādhipa .. 121 ..
5.8.d:
हाटकेश्वरजे क्षेत्रे यत्र देवः स्वयं हरः ..
तत्र नागबिलो जातो वल्मीकात्त्रिदशाधिप .. 121 ..
5.8.m:
In the sacred field of Hāṭakeśvara, where the god Hara himself resides,
there a serpent-hole has arisen from an anthill, O lord of the gods, 121

5.8.s:
yena nāgā dharāpṛṣṭhe nirgacchaṃti vrajaṃti ca ..
tena mārgeṇa gatvā tvaṃ pātāle hāṭakeśvaram ..
snātvā pātālagaṃgāyāṃ pūjayasva maheśvaram .. 122 ..
5.8.d:
येन नागा धरापृष्ठे निर्गच्छंति व्रजंति च ..
तेन मार्गेण गत्वा त्वं पाताले हाटकेश्वरम् ..
स्नात्वा पातालगंगायां पूजयस्व महेश्वरम् .. 122 ..
5.8.m:
By which the serpents come out and go on the surface of the earth.
Having gone by that path to Hāṭakeśvara in Pātāla,
having bathed in the Pātālagaṅgā, worship Maheśvara! 122

5.8.s:
tataḥ pāpavinirmukto bhaviṣyasi na saṃśayaḥ ..
saṃprāpsyasi ca bhūyo'pi devarājyamakaṇṭakam .. 123 ..
5.8.d:
ततः पापविनिर्मुक्तो भविष्यसि न संशयः ..
संप्राप्स्यसि च भूयोऽपि देवराज्यमकण्टकम् .. 123 ..
5.8.m:
Then you will become freed from sin, there is no doubt;
and you will obtain once again the unimpeded sovereignty of the gods.” 123

5.8.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
atha śakraḥ samākarṇya tāṃ giraṃ gaganotthitām ..
jagāma satvaraṃ tatra yatra nāgabilaḥ sa ca .. 124 ..
5.8.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
अथ शक्रः समाकर्ण्य तां गिरं गगनोत्थिताम् ..
जगाम सत्वरं तत्र यत्र नागबिलः स च .. 124 ..
5.8.m:
Sūta said:
Then Śakra, hearing that voice arising from the sky,
went swiftly to where that serpent-hole was. 124

5.8.s:
tataḥ praviśya pātālaṃ gaṃgātoyapariplutaḥ ..
pūjayāmāsa talliṃgaṃ hāṭakeśvarasaṃjñitam .. 125 ..
5.8.d:
ततः प्रविश्य पातालं गंगातोयपरिप्लुतः ..
पूजयामास तल्लिंगं हाटकेश्वरसंज्ञितम् .. 125 ..
5.8.m:
Then, having entered Pātāla and immersed himself in the waters of the Gaṅgā,
he worshipped that liṅga known as Hāṭakeśvara. 125

5.8.s:
atha tasya kṣaṇājjātaṃ śarīraṃ malavarjitam ..
durgandhaśca gato nāśaṃ tejovṛddhirbabhūva ha .. 126 ..
5.8.d:
अथ तस्य क्षणाज्जातं शरीरं मलवर्जितम् ..
दुर्गन्धश्च गतो नाशं तेजोवृद्धिर्बभूव ह .. 126 ..
5.8.m:
Then in an instant his body became free of impurity,
and the foul odor vanished, and an increase of splendor took place. 126

5.8.s:
etasminnaṃtare prāptā brahmaviṣṇumukhāḥ surāḥ ..
procuśca devarājaṃ taṃ muktapāpaṃ praharṣitāḥ .. 127 ..
5.8.d:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे प्राप्ता ब्रह्मविष्णुमुखाः सुराः ..
प्रोचुश्च देवराजं तं मुक्तपापं प्रहर्षिताः .. 127 ..
5.8.m:
At that moment, the gods led by Brahmā and Viṣṇu arrived
and, greatly delighted, spoke to that king of the gods who was freed from sin: 127

5.8.s:
prāptastu medhyatāṃ śakra vimukto brahmahatyayā ..
tasmādāgaccha gacchāmaḥ sahitāstridaśālayam .. 128 ..
5.8.d:
प्राप्तस्तु मेध्यतां शक्र विमुक्तो ब्रह्महत्यया ..
तस्मादागच्छ गच्छामः सहितास्त्रिदशालयम् .. 128 ..
5.8.m:
“You have attained purity, O Śakra, freed from the murder of a brahmin;
therefore come, let us go together to the abode of the gods! 128

5.8.s:
etannāga bilaṃ śakra punaḥ pūraya pāṃsubhiḥ ..
no cedāgatya cānena mānuṣāḥ siddhihetavaḥ .. 129 ..
5.8.d:
एतन्नाग बिलं शक्र पुनः पूरय पांसुभिः ..
नो चेदागत्य चानेन मानुषाः सिद्धिहेतवः .. 129 ..
5.8.m:
O Śakra, fill this serpent-hole again with dust;
otherwise, human beings seeking perfections, having come through this [hole], 129

5.8.s:
etalliṃgaṃ samabhyarcya snātvā bhāgīrathījale ..
api pāpasamāyuktā yāsyaṃti paramāṃ gatim .. 6.8.130 ..
tataste tridaśāḥ sarve sa ca devaṃ śatakratuḥ ..
praṇipatya punaḥ proccaiḥ prajagmustridaśālayam ...3...
5.8.d:
एतल्लिंगं समभ्यर्च्य स्नात्वा भागीरथीजले ..
अपि पापसमायुक्ता यास्यंति परमां गतिम् .. 6.8.130 ..
ततस्ते त्रिदशाः सर्वे स च देवं शतक्रतुः ..
प्रणिपत्य पुनः प्रोच्चैः प्रजग्मुस्त्रिदशालयम् ...3...
5.8.m:
Having bathed in the waters of the Bhāgīrathī and worshipped this liṅga,
even though joined with sin, will attain the supreme state.” 130
Then all those gods and Śatakratu,
having bowed down to the god, departed aloud once again to the abode of the gods. 131

5.8.s:
tato jajñe mahāṃstatra svarge vṛtravadhotsavaḥ ..
devendratvamanuprāpte punaḥ śakre dvijottamāḥ .. 132 ..
5.8.d:
ततो जज्ञे महांस्तत्र स्वर्गे वृत्रवधोत्सवः ..
देवेन्द्रत्वमनुप्राप्ते पुनः शक्रे द्विजोत्तमाः .. 132 ..
5.8.m:
Then a great festival celebrating the slaying of Vṛtra took place there in heaven,
when Śakra obtained the lordship of the gods again, O best of brahmins. 132

5.8.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
etadvaḥ sarvamākhyātaṃ hāṭakeśvarasaṃbhavam ..
māhātmyaṃ brāhmaṇaśreṣṭhāḥ sarvapātakanāśanam .. 133 ..
5.8.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
एतद्वः सर्वमाख्यातं हाटकेश्वरसंभवम् ..
माहात्म्यं ब्राह्मणश्रेष्ठाः सर्वपातकनाशनम् .. 133 ..
5.8.m:
Sūta said:
All this māhātmya relating to Hāṭakeśvara,
which destroys all sins, has been told to you, O best of brahmins. 133

5.8.s:
yaścaitatkīrtayedbhaktyā śṛṇoti ca samāhitaḥ ..
sa yāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ jarā maraṇavarjitam.. 134 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye vṛtravadhavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭamo 'dhyāyaḥ .. 8 .. cha ..
5.8.d:
यश्चैतत्कीर्तयेद्भक्त्या शृणोति च समाहितः ..
स याति परमं स्थानं जरा मरणवर्जितम्.. 134 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये वृत्रवधवर्णनंनामाष्टमो ऽध्यायः .. 8 .. छ ..
5.8.m:
And whoever proclaims this with devotion or listens attentively,
he goes to the supreme abode, free of old age and death. 134
Thus ends the eighth chapter, named “The Description of the Slaying of Vṛtra,” in the Māhātmya of the Sacred Field of Hāṭakeśvara, in the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, the sixth [section], in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses. 8.

5.9.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
atha śakraḥ samāhūya proce saṃvartakānilam ..
hāṭakeśvarajekṣetre mahānnāgabilo'sti vai .. 1 ..
5.9.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
अथ शक्रः समाहूय प्रोचे संवर्तकानिलम् ..
हाटकेश्वरजेक्षेत्रे महान्नागबिलोऽस्ति वै .. 1 ..
5.9.m:
Sūta said:
Then Śakra, having summoned the Saṃvartaka wind, said:
“In the sacred field of Hāṭakeśvara there is indeed a great serpent-hole. 1

5.9.s:
taṃ pūraya mamādeśāddrutaṃ gatvā'bhipāṃsubhiḥ ..
yena na syādgatistatra kasyacinmṛtyudharmiṇaḥ ..2..
5.9.d:
तं पूरय ममादेशाद्द्रुतं गत्वाऽभिपांसुभिः ..
येन न स्याद्गतिस्तत्र कस्यचिन्मृत्युधर्मिणः ..2..
5.9.m:
By my command, go swiftly and fill it with dust,
so that there will be no access there for any mortal being.” 2

5.9.s:
.. vāyuruvāca .. ..
tavādeśānmayā pūrvaṃ pūrito vivaro yadā ...
liṃgodbhavastadā śāpaḥ pradatto me purāriṇā .. 3 ..
5.9.d:
.. वायुरुवाच .. ..
तवादेशान्मया पूर्वं पूरितो विवरो यदा ...
लिंगोद्भवस्तदा शापः प्रदत्तो मे पुरारिणा .. 3 ..
5.9.m:
Vāyu said:
“When formerly, by your command, the opening was filled by me
at the appearance of the liṅga, a curse was pronounced on me by the enemy of Tripura: 3

5.9.s:
yasmālliṃgaṃ mamaitadvai tvayā pāṃsubhirāvṛtam ..
tasmātsamānadharmā tvaṃ gandhavāho bhaviṣyasi .. 4 .
5.9.d:
यस्माल्लिंगं ममैतद्वै त्वया पांसुभिरावृतम् ..
तस्मात्समानधर्मा त्वं गन्धवाहो भविष्यसि .. 4 .
5.9.m:
‘Because this liṅga of mine was covered with dust by you,
therefore you will become a carrier of odors with the same nature [for both]: 4

5.9.s:
yadvatkarpūrajaṃ gandhaṃ samagraṃ tvaṃ hi vakṣyasi ..
amedhyasaṃbhavaṃ tadvanmama vākyādasaṃśayam ..5..
5.9.d:
यद्वत्कर्पूरजं गन्धं समग्रं त्वं हि वक्ष्यसि ..
अमेध्यसंभवं तद्वन्मम वाक्यादसंशयम् ..5..
5.9.m:
Just as you will carry all the fragrance born of camphor,
even so you will carry [the odor] born of impurities, without a doubt, by my word.’ 5

5.9.s:
tasmātkuru prasādaṃ me viditvaitatsureśvara ..
kṛtye'sminsma ryatāmanyastripurārerbibhemyaham ..6..
5.9.d:
तस्मात्कुरु प्रसादं मे विदित्वैतत्सुरेश्वर ..
कृत्येऽस्मिन्स्म र्यतामन्यस्त्रिपुरारेर्बिभेम्यहम् ..6..
5.9.m:
Therefore, knowing this, grant me favor, O lord of the gods;
let someone else be thought of for this task; I fear the enemy of Tripura.” 6

5.9.s:
tataḥ saṃciṃtayāmāsa pūraṇaṃ tridaśādhipaḥ ..
tasya nāgabilasyaiva naiva kiṃcidavaikṣata ..7..
5.9.d:
ततः संचिंतयामास पूरणं त्रिदशाधिपः ..
तस्य नागबिलस्यैव नैव किंचिदवैक्षत ..7..
5.9.m:
Then the lord of the gods reflected on the filling
of that serpent-hole, but did not see any [way at all]. 7

5.9.s:
tatastaṃ prāha devejyaḥsvaya meva śatakratum ..
kasmāttvaṃ vyākulībhūtaḥ kṛtye'smiṃstridaśādhipa .. 8 ..
5.9.d:
ततस्तं प्राह देवेज्यःस्वय मेव शतक्रतुम् ..
कस्मात्त्वं व्याकुलीभूतः कृत्येऽस्मिंस्त्रिदशाधिप .. 8 ..
5.9.m:
Then the preceptor of the gods himself said to that Śatakratu:
“Why have you become troubled over this task, O lord of the gods? 8

5.9.s:
asti parvatamukhyo'tra nāmnā khyāto himālayaḥ ..
tasya putratrayaṃ jātaṃ tacca śakra śṛṇuṣva me .. 9 ..
5.9.d:
अस्ति पर्वतमुख्योऽत्र नाम्ना ख्यातो हिमालयः ..
तस्य पुत्रत्रयं जातं तच्च शक्र शृणुष्व मे .. 9 ..
5.9.m:
There is a foremost mountain here, known by the name Himālaya;
three sons were born to him; listen to that from me, O Śakra! 9”

5.9.s:
mainākaḥ prathamaḥ prokto dvitīyo naṃdivardhanaḥ..
raktaśṛṃgastṛtīyastu parvataḥ parikīrtitaḥ .. 6.9.10 ..
5.9.d:
मैनाकः प्रथमः प्रोक्तो द्वितीयो नंदिवर्धनः..
रक्तशृंगस्तृतीयस्तु पर्वतः परिकीर्तितः .. 6.9.10 ..
5.9.m: Maināka is called the first, the second is Nandivardhana, / and the third mountain is known as Raktaśṛṅga.

5.9.s:
sa mainākaḥ samudrāṃtaḥ praviṣṭaḥ śakra te bhayāt ..
pakṣābhyāṃ sahito'dyāpi sa tatraiva vyavasthitaḥ .. 11 ..
5.9.d:
स मैनाकः समुद्रांतः प्रविष्टः शक्र ते भयात् ..
पक्षाभ्यां सहितोऽद्यापि स तत्रैव व्यवस्थितः .. 11 ..
5.9.m: That Maināka entered into the ocean out of fear of you, O Śakra. / Together with his wings, he remains right there even today.

5.9.s:
naṃdivardhana ityeṣa dvitīyaḥ parikīrtitaḥ ..
vasiṣṭhāśramajo randhraste na kṛtsnaḥ prapūritaḥ .. 12 ..
5.9.d:
नंदिवर्धन इत्येष द्वितीयः परिकीर्तितः ..
वसिष्ठाश्रमजो रन्ध्रस्ते न कृत्स्नः प्रपूरितः .. 12 ..
5.9.m: This second one is known as Nandivardhana; / by him the chasm that arose at the hermitage of Vasiṣṭha was entirely filled.

5.9.s:
himācalasamādeśādvasiṣṭhasya ca sanmuneḥ ..
devabhūmiṃ parityajya sa gatastatra satvaram .. 13 ..
5.9.d:
हिमाचलसमादेशाद्वसिष्ठस्य च सन्मुनेः ..
देवभूमिं परित्यज्य स गतस्तत्र सत्वरम् .. 13 ..
5.9.m: By command of the Himālaya and of the noble sage Vasiṣṭha, / abandoning the land of the gods, he quickly went there.

5.9.s:
tṛtīyastiṣṭhate'dyāpi raktaśṛṃgaḥ smṛto'tra yaḥ ..
tamānaya sahasrākṣa bilaṃ sārpaṃ prapūraya .. 14 ..
5.9.d:
तृतीयस्तिष्ठतेऽद्यापि रक्तशृंगः स्मृतोऽत्र यः ..
तमानय सहस्राक्ष बिलं सार्पं प्रपूरय .. 14 ..
5.9.m: The third, who is known here as Raktaśṛṅga, still remains. / Bring him, O thousand-eyed Indra, and fill the serpents' cavity!

5.9.s:
nānyathā pūrituṃ śakyo bilo'yaṃ tridaśādhipa ..
taṃ muktvā parvata śreṣṭhaṃ satyametanmayoditam .. 15 ..
5.9.d:
नान्यथा पूरितुं शक्यो बिलोऽयं त्रिदशाधिप ..
तं मुक्त्वा पर्वत श्रेष्ठं सत्यमेतन्मयोदितम् .. 15 ..
5.9.m: In no other way can this chasm be filled, O lord of the gods, / except by that best of mountains: this which I have spoken is true.

5.9.s:
.. sūta uvāca ..
tacchrutvā devapūjyasya vacanaṃ tridaśādhipaḥ ..
jagāma satvaraṃ tatra sa yatrāste himālayaḥ .. .. 16 ..
5.9.d:
.. सूत उवाच ..
तच्छ्रुत्वा देवपूज्यस्य वचनं त्रिदशाधिपः ..
जगाम सत्वरं तत्र स यत्रास्ते हिमालयः .. .. 16 ..
5.9.m: Sūta said: / Having heard that statement of the teacher of the gods, the lord of the gods / went quickly to where the Himālaya was.

5.9.s:
tataḥ provāca taṃ gatvā sāmapūrvamidaṃ vacaḥ ..
himācalaṃ giriśreṣṭhaṃ siddhacāraṇasevitam .. 17 ..
5.9.d:
ततः प्रोवाच तं गत्वा सामपूर्वमिदं वचः ..
हिमाचलं गिरिश्रेष्ठं सिद्धचारणसेवितम् .. 17 ..
5.9.m: Then, having approached Himācala, the best of mountains, / attended by siddhas and cāraṇas, he spoke these conciliatory words:

5.9.s:
.. indra uvāca .. ..
hāṭakeśvaraje kṣetre mahānnāgabilaḥ sthitaḥ ..
tena gatvā narā devaṃ pātāle hāṭakeśvaram .. 18 ..
5.9.d:
.. इन्द्र उवाच .. ..
हाटकेश्वरजे क्षेत्रे महान्नागबिलः स्थितः ..
तेन गत्वा नरा देवं पाताले हाटकेश्वरम् .. 18 ..
5.9.m: Indra said: / In the sacred field born of Hāṭakeśvara there is a great serpent-chasm. / Going through it, men, to the god Hāṭakeśvara in Pātāla—

5.9.s:
pūjayiṣyaṃti ye kecidapi pāpaparāyaṇāḥ ..
mayā sārdhaṃ kariṣyaṃti tataḥ sparddhāṃ nagottama .. 19 ..
5.9.d:
पूजयिष्यंति ये केचिदपि पापपरायणाः ..
मया सार्धं करिष्यंति ततः स्पर्द्धां नगोत्तम .. 19 ..
5.9.m: whosoever they may be, even if devoted to sin, will worship him, / and will then rival me, O best of mountains!

5.9.s:
tasmātputramimaṃ tatra raktaśṛṃgaṃ himālaya ..
preṣayasva bilo yena pūryate so'hisaṃbhavaḥ .. 6.9.20 ..
5.9.d:
तस्मात्पुत्रमिमं तत्र रक्तशृंगं हिमालय ..
प्रेषयस्व बिलो येन पूर्यते सोऽहिसंभवः .. 6.9.20 ..
5.9.m: Therefore send this son Raktaśṛṅga there, O Himālaya, / so that the chasm arising from the serpents may be filled.

5.9.s:
kuruṣva tvaṃ mamātithyaṃ gṛhaprāptasya parvata ..
ātmaputrapradānena kīrtiṃ prāpsyasyalaukikīm .. 21 ..
5.9.d:
कुरुष्व त्वं ममातिथ्यं गृहप्राप्तस्य पर्वत ..
आत्मपुत्रप्रदानेन कीर्तिं प्राप्स्यस्यलौकिकीम् .. 21 ..
5.9.m: Offer hospitality to me who have arrived at your home, O mountain! / By giving your own son, you will obtain extraordinary fame.

5.9.s:
bāḍhamityeva so'pyuktvā pūjayitvā ca devapam ..
tataḥ provāca taṃ putraṃ raktaśṛṃgaṃ himālayaḥ .. 22 ..
5.9.d:
बाढमित्येव सोऽप्युक्त्वा पूजयित्वा च देवपम् ..
ततः प्रोवाच तं पुत्रं रक्तशृंगं हिमालयः .. 22 ..
5.9.m: Having said 'So be it!' and having honoured the lord of the gods, / the Himālaya then addressed that son, Raktaśṛṅga:

5.9.s:
tavārthāya sahasrākṣaḥ putra prāpto mamāṃtikam ..
tasmādgaccha drutaṃ tatra yatra nāgabilaḥ sthitaḥ .. 23 ..
5.9.d:
तवार्थाय सहस्राक्षः पुत्र प्राप्तो ममांतिकम् ..
तस्माद्गच्छ द्रुतं तत्र यत्र नागबिलः स्थितः .. 23 ..
5.9.m: O son, the thousand-eyed Indra has come into my presence for your sake. / Therefore go quickly to where the serpent-chasm is situated.

5.9.s:
pūrayitvā mamādeśāttaṃ tvaṃ śakrasya kṛtsnaśaḥ ..
sukhī bhava sahānena tathānyaiḥ surasattamaiḥ .. 24 ..
5.9.d:
पूरयित्वा ममादेशात्तं त्वं शक्रस्य कृत्स्नशः ..
सुखी भव सहानेन तथान्यैः सुरसत्तमैः .. 24 ..
5.9.m: Having completely filled it by my command, for Śakra's sake, / be happy along with him and with the other foremost gods!

5.9.s:
.. raktaśṛṃga uvāca .. ..
nāhaṃ tatra gamiṣyāmi martya bhūmau kathaṃcana ..
yatra kaṇṭakino vṛkṣā rūkṣāḥ phalavivarjitāḥ .. 25 ..
5.9.d:
.. रक्तशृंग उवाच .. ..
नाहं तत्र गमिष्यामि मर्त्य भूमौ कथंचन ..
यत्र कण्टकिनो वृक्षा रूक्षाः फलविवर्जिताः .. 25 ..
5.9.m: Raktaśṛṅga said: / I will never go there to the mortal world, / where trees are thorny, dry, and devoid of fruit;

5.9.s:
na siddhā na ca gaṃdharvā na devā na ca kiṃnarāḥ ..
na ca tīrthāni ramyāṇi na nadyo vimalodakāḥ .. 26 ..
5.9.d:
न सिद्धा न च गंधर्वा न देवा न च किंनराः ..
न च तीर्थानि रम्याणि न नद्यो विमलोदकाः .. 26 ..
5.9.m: where there are no siddhas, no gandharvas, no gods, and no kiṃnaras, / and neither charming sacred fords nor rivers of clear water;

5.9.s:
tathā pāpasamācārā manuṣyāḥ śīlavarjitāḥ ..
duṣṭacittāḥ sadā sarve tiryagyonigatā api .. 27 ..
5.9.d:
तथा पापसमाचारा मनुष्याः शीलवर्जिताः ..
दुष्टचित्ताः सदा सर्वे तिर्यग्योनिगता अपि .. 27 ..
5.9.m: and where men are of sinful conduct, devoid of moral character, / and all are always evil-minded, even those born in animal wombs.

5.9.s:
tathā mama nagaśreṣṭha pakṣau dvāvapi kartitau ..
śakreṇa tena no śaktirgaṃtumasti kathaṃcana .. 28 ..
5.9.d:
तथा मम नगश्रेष्ठ पक्षौ द्वावपि कर्तितौ ..
शक्रेण तेन नो शक्तिर्गंतुमस्ति कथंचन .. 28 ..
5.9.m: Moreover, O best of mountains, both of my wings were cut off / by Śakra; because of that, there is no ability to go whatsoever.

5.9.s:
tasmātkaṃcitsahasrākṣa upāyaṃ tatkṛte param ..
ciṃtayatveva māṃ muktvā satyametanmayoditam .. 29 ..
5.9.d:
तस्मात्कंचित्सहस्राक्ष उपायं तत्कृते परम् ..
चिंतयत्वेव मां मुक्त्वा सत्यमेतन्मयोदितम् .. 29 ..
5.9.m: Therefore let the thousand-eyed Indra devise some other supreme means for that, / leaving me aside; this which I have spoken is true.

5.9.s:
.. śakra uvāca.. ..
aha tvāṃ tatra neṣyāmi svahastena vidāritam ..
tatrāpi suśubhā vṛkṣā bhaviṣyaṃti tavāśrayāḥ .. 6.9.30 ..
5.9.d:
.. शक्र उवाच.. ..
अह त्वां तत्र नेष्यामि स्वहस्तेन विदारितम् ..
तत्रापि सुशुभा वृक्षा भविष्यंति तवाश्रयाः .. 6.9.30 ..
5.9.m: Śakra said: / I myself will carry you there, lifted by my own hand. / There too, very beautiful trees will become your resorts;

5.9.s:
tathā puṇyāni tīrthāni devatāyatanāni ca ..
samaṃtātte bhaviṣyaṃti munīnāmāśramāstathā .. 31 ..
5.9.d:
तथा पुण्यानि तीर्थानि देवतायतनानि च ..
समंतात्ते भविष्यंति मुनीनामाश्रमास्तथा .. 31 ..
5.9.m: and holy sacred fords and temples of deities, / as well as hermitages of sages, will arise all around you.

5.9.s:
atrasthasya prabhāvo yastava parvata naṃdana ..
madvākyāttatra saṃsthasya koṭisaṃkhyo bhaviṣyati .. 32 ..
5.9.d:
अत्रस्थस्य प्रभावो यस्तव पर्वत नंदन ..
मद्वाक्यात्तत्र संस्थस्य कोटिसंख्यो भविष्यति .. 32 ..
5.9.m: The power that you have while remaining here, O son of the mountain, / will, by my word, become ten-millionfold when you are settled there.

5.9.s:
tathā ye mānavāstatra pāpātmāno'pi bhūtale ..
vipāpmāno bhaviṣyaṃti sahasā tava darśanāt .. 33 ..
5.9.d:
तथा ये मानवास्तत्र पापात्मानोऽपि भूतले ..
विपाप्मानो भविष्यंति सहसा तव दर्शनात् .. 33 ..
5.9.m: Moreover, whichever mortals are on the earth there, even if they are sinful, / will instantly become free of sin from your darśana.

5.9.s:
tasmādgaccha drutaṃ tatra mayā sārdhaṃ nagātmaja ..
na cedvajraprahāreṇa kariṣyāmi sahasradhā .. 34 ..
5.9.d:
तस्माद्गच्छ द्रुतं तत्र मया सार्धं नगात्मज ..
न चेद्वज्रप्रहारेण करिष्यामि सहस्रधा .. 34 ..
5.9.m: Therefore go quickly there with me, O son of the mountain! / If not, I shall shatter you into a thousand pieces with a blow of my vajra.

5.9.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā raktaśṛṃgo bhayānvitaḥ..
praviṣṭaḥ sahasāgatya tasminnāgabile gataḥ .. 35 ..
5.9.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा रक्तशृंगो भयान्वितः..
प्रविष्टः सहसागत्य तस्मिन्नागबिले गतः .. 35 ..
5.9.m: Sūta said: / Hearing that speech of his, Raktaśṛṅga was filled with fear. / Coming quickly, he entered into that serpent-chasm.

5.9.s:
nimagno brāhmaṇaśreṣṭhā nāsāgraṃ yāvadeva hi ..
śṛṃgairmanoramaistuṃ gaiḥ samagraiḥ sahitastadā ..
vṛkṣagulmalatākīrṇai ramyapakṣiniṣevitaiḥ .. 36 ..
5.9.d:
निमग्नो ब्राह्मणश्रेष्ठा नासाग्रं यावदेव हि ..
शृंगैर्मनोरमैस्तुं गैः समग्रैः सहितस्तदा ..
वृक्षगुल्मलताकीर्णै रम्यपक्षिनिषेवितैः .. 36 ..
5.9.m: O best of brahmins, he sank in just up to the tip of his nose, / complete with all his lofty, delightful peaks, / covered with trees, bushes, and creepers, and frequented by charming birds.

5.9.s:
evaṃ saṃsthāpya taṃ śakro himācalasutaṃ nagam ..
tataḥ provāca sahṛṣṭo varo mattaḥ pragṛhyatām .. 37 ..
5.9.d:
एवं संस्थाप्य तं शक्रो हिमाचलसुतं नगम् ..
ततः प्रोवाच सहृष्टो वरो मत्तः प्रगृह्यताम् .. 37 ..
5.9.m: Having thus established that mountain, the son of the Himālaya, / Śakra, delighted, then said: 'Let a boon be received from me!'

5.9.s:
.. raktaśṛṃga uvāca .. ..
eṣa eva varo'smākaṃ yattvaṃ tuṣṭaḥ sureśvara ..
kiṃ vareṇa kariṣyāmi tvatprasādādahaṃ sukhī .. 38 .. ..
5.9.d:
.. रक्तशृंग उवाच .. ..
एष एव वरोऽस्माकं यत्त्वं तुष्टः सुरेश्वर ..
किं वरेण करिष्यामि त्वत्प्रसादादहं सुखी .. 38 .. ..
5.9.m: Raktaśṛṅga said: / This alone is our boon: that you are pleased, O lord of the gods. / What will I do with a boon? By your favour, I am happy.

5.9.s:
.. indra uvāca .. ..
na vṛthā darśanaṃ me syādapi svapne nagātmaja ..
kiṃ punardarśane jāte kṛte kṛtye viśeṣataḥ..39..
.. raktaśṛṃga uvāca .. ..
avaśyaṃ yadi deyo me varaḥ sarvasurādhipa ..
vibhavo me dvijārthāya sarvaḥ syātsarvadā vibho ..6.9.4...
5.9.d:
.. इन्द्र उवाच .. ..
न वृथा दर्शनं मे स्यादपि स्वप्ने नगात्मज ..
किं पुनर्दर्शने जाते कृते कृत्ये विशेषतः..39..
.. रक्तशृंग उवाच .. ..
अवश्यं यदि देयो मे वरः सर्वसुराधिप ..
विभवो मे द्विजार्थाय सर्वः स्यात्सर्वदा विभो ..6.9.4...
5.9.m:
Indra said: / The vision of me cannot be in vain, even in a dream, O son of the mountain; / how much less when a direct vision has occurred, especially with the deed accomplished?
Raktaśṛṅga said: / If a boon must certainly be given to me, O lord of all gods, / may all my wealth always be for the sake of the twice-born, O lord!

5.9.s:
.. indra uvāca .. ..
bhaviṣyati mahīpālaścamatkāra iti smṛtaḥ ..
tava mūrdhani viprārthaṃ sa puraṃ sthāpayiṣyati .. 41 ..
5.9.d:
.. इन्द्र उवाच .. ..
भविष्यति महीपालश्चमत्कार इति स्मृतः ..
तव मूर्धनि विप्रार्थं स पुरं स्थापयिष्यति .. 41 ..
5.9.m: Indra said: / There will be an earth-ruler known as Camatkāra; / he will establish a city on your summit for the sake of the brahmins.

5.9.s:
tatra brāhmaṇaśārdūlā vedavedāṃgapāragāḥ..
vibhavaṃ tava niḥśeṣaṃ bhajiṣyaṃti praharṣitāḥ .. 42 ..
5.9.d:
तत्र ब्राह्मणशार्दूला वेदवेदांगपारगाः..
विभवं तव निःशेषं भजिष्यंति प्रहर्षिताः .. 42 ..
5.9.m: There eminent brahmins, masters of the Vedas and Vedāṅgas, / will enjoy your entire wealth, exceedingly delighted.

5.9.s:
tathāhaṃ caitramāsasya caturdaśyāṃ nagātmaja..
kṛṣṇāyāṃ svayamāgatya śṛṃge mukhyatame tava..43..
5.9.d:
तथाहं चैत्रमासस्य चतुर्दश्यां नगात्मज..
कृष्णायां स्वयमागत्य शृंगे मुख्यतमे तव..43..
5.9.m: Moreover, on the fourteenth day of the dark fortnight of the month of Caitra, / having arrived myself, O son of the mountain, on your foremost peak,

5.9.s:
pūjayiṣyāmi deveśaṃ hāṭakeśvarasaṃjñitam ..
sarvairdevagaṇaiḥ sārdhaṃ tathā kiṃnaraguhyakaiḥ ..44..
5.9.d:
पूजयिष्यामि देवेशं हाटकेश्वरसंज्ञितम् ..
सर्वैर्देवगणैः सार्धं तथा किंनरगुह्यकैः ..44..
5.9.m: I will worship the lord of the gods named Hāṭakeśvara, / along with all the hosts of gods, as well as kiṃnaras and guhyakas.

5.9.s:
tamekaṃ divasaṃ cātra śṛṃge tava haraḥ svayam..
asmābhiḥ sahitastuṣṭo nivāsaṃ prakariṣyati .. 45 ..
5.9.d:
तमेकं दिवसं चात्र शृंगे तव हरः स्वयम्..
अस्माभिः सहितस्तुष्टो निवासं प्रकरिष्यति .. 45 ..
5.9.m: And on that single day, Hara himself, pleased, / will take up residence here on your peak, along with us.

5.9.s:
prabhāvastena te mukhya strailokye'pi bhaviṣyati ..
svasti te'stu gamiṣyāmi sāṃprataṃ tridivālayam..46..
5.9.d:
प्रभावस्तेन ते मुख्य स्त्रैलोक्येऽपि भविष्यति ..
स्वस्ति तेऽस्तु गमिष्यामि सांप्रतं त्रिदिवालयम्..46..
5.9.m: By that, your power will become preeminent even in the three worlds. / Hail to you! I shall now go to the celestial abode.

5.9.s:
.. sūta uvāca ....
evamuktvā sahasrākṣastataḥ prāptastriviṣṭapam..
raktaśṛṃgo'pi tasthau ca vyāpya nāgabilaṃ tadā ..47..
5.9.d:
.. सूत उवाच ....
एवमुक्त्वा सहस्राक्षस्ततः प्राप्तस्त्रिविष्टपम्..
रक्तशृंगोऽपि तस्थौ च व्याप्य नागबिलं तदा ..47..
5.9.m: Sūta said: / Having spoken thus, the thousand-eyed Indra went to heaven; / and Raktaśṛṅga remained there, occupying the serpent-chasm.

5.9.s:
tasyopari sumukhyāni tīrthānyāyatanāni ca ..
saṃjātāni munīnāṃ ca saṃjātāśca tathā''śramāḥ .. ..48..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye nāgabilapūrtivarṇanaṃnāma navamo'dhyāyaḥ..9..
5.9.d:
तस्योपरि सुमुख्यानि तीर्थान्यायतनानि च ..
संजातानि मुनीनां च संजाताश्च तथा'ऽश्रमाः .. ..48..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये नागबिलपूर्तिवर्णनंनाम नवमोऽध्यायः..9..
5.9.m:
Upon him arose foremost sacred fords and temples, / and likewise hermitages of sages came into being.
Thus ends the ninth chapter, named 'The Description of the Filling of the Serpent-Chasm', in the Māhātmya of the Sacred Field of Hāṭakeśvara, in the sixth Nāgarakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skandapurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand [verses].
